notes.title: Bugfix Update & Server Browser
notes.content:
Good afternoon all!

A bunch of changes in today's update, mainly focused on ease of entry for anyone who purchases the game in the future and wants to play without getting into a server.

Now, the default "Play" option in the menu will spawn you into a solo roam map, let you roam around, collect weapons, items, etc, fight snakes, and generally get a feel for the game.

In addition, the server browser has been fixed, so now anyone who wants to host their own server can, and it will appear in the in-game server browser. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uQzlQiZ.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Master Server Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

It's been a while! This update migrates DTOv2 onto Unity 2020, and importantly adds in Steam Master Server support to replace the old Master Server. What does this mean? Well, now anyone can actually host their own server, and anyone else can join it.

Here's what you'll need to do, if you want to host your own server:
[list]
[*] DMZ your router (google how to)
[*] Forward the port you're hosting your server on on your router (google how to)
[*] Disable windows firewall - Steam MS doesn't like this
[*] Get your public ip address, port, and put it into one of the server .bat files that comes in the same directory as DownToOne.exe - ie "SERVER_WORKS_STANDARD.bat" and replace the ip/port there with yours
[*] Double-click the bat to host your dedicated server
[/list]

Alternately, there's now an option to host your own private server (ie. LAN only) if you don't want to do that, and just want to explore the map when there are no servers around. Just head into the main menu, click play, and click "Create a server".

As always, join the official Down To One Discord for updates [url=https://discord.gg/jT5EArz]https://discord.gg/jT5EArz[/url]

notes.title: Down To One v2 Open Beta Testing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7604361/a402dcf3120a823e12ce745fa9478f46cb6e3c31.jpg[/img]

Happy Easter all! 

Some exciting news for anyone who has Down To One in their Steam library - the very first Beta servers for DTOv2 will be opening up today, available to anyone who has DTOv1.[b] In approximately 12 hours[/b] from this post, you'll be able to jump in to a new, revamped Down To One experience, with some new features to look out for. Here's a quick TL;DR on how to play below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7604361/6c651e367b5924bf6642608a9343d7ff8b756a2c.gif[/img]
[h3]You now play in one of 3 teams - Blusec, Redsec, or Independent[/h3]
[list]
[*]Secure a "home base" for your team by capturing an area's radio tower
[*]The team with the most players in the playable area will slowly gain capture points
[*]The team that ends up with 100 capture points will win the round
[*]The last 10 minutes of each round is a traditional Battle-Royale, fight to the death.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7604361/ab2d14c3e760bb6f97d127c9e5b17ebaecb6f544.gif[/img]

As well as the new main game objective, there's a few new features for those that haven't played any of the previous DTOv2 betas, here's some of the most prominent ones:
[list]
[*] Players can now Vault over obstacles (default: V)
[*] Players can now lean a variable amount (default: G + Scrollwheel)
[*] Players can now pickup a large array of environmental objects, including objects which spawn items. This can be used to construct a "base"
[*] Many environmental objects are now destructible
[*] The jeep is now drivable
[*] Players can now lean a variable amount (default: G + Scrollwheel)
[*] There are multiple new areas on the map
[*] Players can now bring up the map in the UI (default: M)
[*] Players can now select/swap their team throughout the round (default: L)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7604361/c855b5283502c97e0cc971d098add71242756268.gif[/img]

As always, join the Down To One [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/6ABza2f]Discord[/url] to chat as you get into the new beta!

notes.title: December Status Update & DTOv2 Devblog 5
notes.content:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/7uB5HMs.jpg][/img]
2018 has just about wrapped up, so let’s take a look at what’s new since our last devblog, and where Down To One v2 will be kicking off next year!

[b]A change of pace[/b]
One of the biggest changes to Down To One v2 will be the new “mode” that the game is played in. It’s not really a mode so much as a new game, as Down To One moves from a Battle-Royale esque, single life, solo concept to a team-based, competitive survival, King-Of-The-Hill.
Specific changes include:
[list]
[*] There will be three teams that you can join in any round – [b]RedSec[/b], [b]BluSec[/b] and [b]Independent[/b]. 
[*] Rounds will now target 60 minutes, or however long it takes for a team to reach 100 points.
[*] Each team is awarded points if they control the playable area, by having the most members inside of it.
[*] The last 3 minutes of each round will end how classic Down To One rounds finish, with the playable area closing in and respawns disabled, with the last player standing earning extra points for their team.
[*] Rounds will now target 60 minutes, or however long it takes for a team to reach 100 points.
[/list]
This change is important to having a stable playerbase when DTOv2 releases for free. Battle Royale games are simply not sustainable in terms of players required, for all but the absolute largest titles, and this change will allow the game to be played by anyone, at any time, just by joining a currently active round.
Also, the concept stays true to DTO’s original goal of competitive survival – you will still have to loot food, water, weapons, and bandages, and dying will still be a big deal. Essentially, it’s a modernised format of the game that allows for a lot more flexibility. You can now play with your friends, jump on to support your team for 20 minutes and jump off again, and have a lot more options than just having to commit to a full BR game (and then waiting 30 minutes for another round to start if you die 3 minutes in).

[img=https://i.imgur.com/HOjG0F3.jpg]Spot the new UI down the bottom right![/img]

[b]Vaulting[/b]
New gameplay isn’t worth shouting about without the mechanics to back it up! Vaulting is now a thing in Down To One v2, primarily to get you over ground-based obstacles (like fences) easier.
[img=https://i.imgur.com/Hrtfjrg.gif][/img]

[b]Vehicles[/b]
Cars (well, the one test car) actually works over the network now! #DayZTakeNotes
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/1xlodLdiMfEIN2Ulgs/giphy.gif][/img]

[b]Monetization[/b]
An easy, simple, and good value monetization system is needed for DTOv2 to keep servers running. After a poll on our official Discord, the "Down To One Competitors Upgrade" is looking like the system that will be implemented for DTOv2 - this would give you:
[list]
[*] Custom Role on Discord & Highlighted name in-game
[*] Access to Character Customization skins (only 4, but more than just default)
[*] [i]Contentious bit[/i] 5 more perk points than a default player (default players would still be able to fill up their perk slots, but obviously this directly translates into a paid advantage, however minimal. I would personally only consider it because the advantage would be so small, that if you are a better player without this, you will still always beat a player with it.
[/list]

Importantly, Down To One v2 is now in[b]open beta[/b] – all you need to do is join the official Down To One Discord to gain access to the beta branch. Join here: [url=https://discord.gg/SEMD4AT] https://discord.gg/SEMD4AT [/url]
Don't forget to follow [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/status/970146406982852610]@DownToOneGame[/url] on Twitter as well, and from the team (me) here at Gadget Games, Merry Christmas & a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Better Beta - July Status Update & DTOv2 Devblog 4
notes.content:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/GfigLzs.jpg]
Down To One v2 is now in early stage Beta testing!
With that out of the way, let's take a look at what you can expect if you're a beta tester, and how to join in and help make the most competitive Battle Royale shooter on PC!

[b]New Things[/b]
Cloud-Saved progress is now a thing, with the (currently up & running) Master Server now home to your Perks, in-game Cash, and other preferences. This is a major piece of key infrastructure for DTOv2, so it needs as much testing as possible before release. The old system in DTOv1 used Google Sheets (yes, Google Sheets) for too many elements, which, obviously, was a bad idea. 

[b]Ladders [/b]
Ladders have now been reworked, and are considerably less janky than in Down To One v1. Now, when you are stationary, your characters' hands will use procedural animation to place themselves on the nearest rungs of the ladder, to make for a more immersive visual experience.
[img= https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/364292977121689600/470073116651946018/LadderCompressed.gif?width=400&height=226]

[b]Dynamic Weather[/b]
Background Audio has been reworked now to improve performance and provide more capability for cool things, like dynamic weather. Speaking of dynamic weather, you might experience a light shower next time you play.
[img= https://i.imgur.com/w38t7EC.jpg]

[b]Scope Glint[/b]
Another fun feature that helps to balance out the strength of sniper rifles (that were too strong in the original Down To One) is Scope Glint. When a player with a sniper rifle is looking down their scope, in your direction, you'll have the chance to spy them out with a small, telltale glint. See if you can spot it here:
[img= https://i.imgur.com/J8LYtX6.gif]

There's also a few more big-ticket items that won't make their way into any devblogs before release - if you'd like to check them out, the only way to do so is to participate in the next Beta tests on the official Down To One Discord! Join here: [url=https://discord.gg/SEMD4AT] https://discord.gg/SEMD4AT [/url]
Don't forget to follow [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/status/970146406982852610]@DownToOneGame[/url] on Twitter as well.

notes.title: Breaking Everything - Post-February Status Update & DTO 2.0 Devblog 3
notes.content:
Hi All,

It's time to take a look at what's been going on in #DTOv2 development since our last devblog in January! 

[b]New Destruction System[/b]
Since launch, the props around DTOs map have always felt a little bit flat. This is changing in 2.0, with an all-new networked destruction system. 
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/3eObfJst7AnTIxRp0A/giphy.gif]
There currently is about 15 of the smaller props on the map that have the new destruction system added. Pared with the new item-placing system, you can build a fortification, and destroy it too!

(It's a good reason to actually use grenades now as well)
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/5UqRF0YQR1yYd4rluJ/giphy.gif]

[b]Variable Lean System[/b]
What's an FPS in 2018 without a way to lean around corners? In Down To One 2.0, you'll now have the ability to lean as far around a corner as you need - to the exact degree. 
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/1BdIOUOD9UMEh2zKfR/giphy.gif]

[b]First Pre-Alpha Test[/b]
We've hit a good milestone in the journey to 2.0, with the first (and second) pre-alpha test run in February. As always, there's still plenty more to add, but DTOv2 is now roughly at feature parity with 1.0, with just about all core systems working.
[img=https://i.imgur.com/D0wkQc2.jpg]

If you're interested in joining future pre-alpha/alpha/beta testing, join our [url=https://discord.gg/HbbJXca]discord[/url] server to get notified exactly when that will happen!

For more updates on what's been happening in 2.0, [url=https://discord.gg/HbbJXca]join the official discord server[/url] now! Don't forget to follow [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/status/970146406982852610]@DownToOneGame[/url] on Twitter as well.

notes.title: Back To The Future - January Status Update & DTO 2.0 Devblog 2
notes.content:
Hi All,

It's time to take a look at what's been going on in #DTOv2 development since December!

[b]New lighting for all materials[/b]
DTOv2 is taking a step back (to the future!) by reimplementing a feature from back when we used an older version of the engine. It's called the Cook-Torrance BRDF, and is what The Order 1866 uses, as well as early versions of DTO. The goal is not only to make DTO's visuals subtly different, but the Cook-Torrance BRDF also lends itself to increasing perceptual sharpness - a win/win in DTO!
Here's a screenshot with added bonus, the new playable area ground-contact effect!
[img=https://i.imgur.com/39NNjLl.jpg]

[b]Reworked Explosions[/b]
Using a custom built particle shader that reacts to lighting (and won't get downgraded before release - it's high performance too)
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/26DMYSGa6a99wKlwY/giphy.gif]

As well as explosions, many other particle effects have been reworked (old/new);
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/l4pT770H0nRNKTQe4/200w_d.gif][img=https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOwGpMT8a5EhRMbUk/200w_d.gif]

[b]Underground Areas[/b]
Thanks to a recent poll on our discord server, underground areas of the map are coming to 2.0! This is part of a broader effort to give more character to the map, and make it interesting to just explore, even for seasoned DTO players.
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/xThtahXNgfVf3Cv8vm/giphy-downsized-large.gif]

[b]New UI[/b]
Continuing the new UI improvements, with a menu that doesn't look like it was put together in paint
[img=https://i.imgur.com/9RVB149.jpg]

Those are probably the most interesting/visual changes in the last month or so, but as well as that, there's only a few more bugs left to squash before a public 2.0 pre-alpha feature parity test can go ahead - join our [url=https://discord.gg/HbbJXca]discord[/url] server to get notified exactly when that will happen!

For more updates on what's been happening in 2.0, [url=https://discord.gg/HbbJXca]join the official discord server[/url] now!

notes.title: DTO 2.0 Devblog 1 - A change of hands
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/ng9RrNS.jpg][/img]
[b]DTO 2.0 Devblog 1 - A change of hands[/b]
No! Down To One is not changing hands as you might be thinking, but this devblog details some of the changes I've been making to the various systems in DTO for its biggest overhaul yet, including graphics, viewmodel (including your hands!), and new main gamemode.
 
[b]Viewmodels in Unity[/b]
One of the biggest issues with Down To One 1.0 is the characters hands. In DTO v1, I used a multi-camera setup, with a second camera that only renders the characters hands and weapon. The disadvantages of this:
[list]
[*]Post-Processing that relies on depth buffers (like Ambient Occlusion) doesn't work with a multi-cam setup without an incredible amount of hacks.[/*]
[*]Post-Processing on the second camera in general isn't plug-and-play, and required edits to shader code, which broke anytime any of my Post-Processing effects (like PRISM, the one I make) had to update.[/*]
[*]Extra overhead of rendering 2 cameras can really hit Unity. Unity is not built for 2-camera, large world setups, particularly when trying to use deferred rendering. Unless they've fixed it recently, there are still some 2-camera gotchas that mean each camera loops through lists of every renderer in the scene multiple times even if they're not needed to be rendered. In a game as big as DTO, this has an impact.[/*]
[*]Objects rendered by the second camera don't receive shadows and look 'floaty'[/*]
[*]Objects rendered by the second camera don't cast shadows by default[/*]
[/list]
After experimenting with command buffers and tweaking the multi-camera setup, I ended up with DTO V2's solution to this problem: A 'simple' shader edit. Now, whenever a renderer needs to be rendered in front of anything else, a few things happen:
[list]
[*]It is registered in a dictionary on the main camera as a "First Person Renderer"[/*]
[*]All materials in that renderer are set to use a "FIRST_PERSON" shader keyword until they are unregistered[/*]
[*]This keyword enables code in the vertex shader that forces the model to use a custom view matrix (ie. a set Field Of View), and also offsets the depth the model is rendered at, so that it is always rendered in front of anything else.[/*]
[/list]
An issue popped up with this: The characters feet would render on top of everything as well. This was fixed by the addition of a script that can be added to any renderer+material to tell the material never to get "first-person'ed".
Also, the custom projection matrix was not as easy as calling GL.GetGPUProjectionMatrix in Unity, as for whatever reason, it does not return the actual values that the shader uses. So, a C#-side conversion from OpenGL into DirectX Viewmodel has to be made to un-flip it and correct it:
[code]public void SetCustomProjMatrix(Camera fromThisCamera)
{
                var projectionMatrix = GL.GetGPUProjectionMatrix(fromThisCamera.projectionMatrix,false);// fromThisCamera.projectionMatrix;
                if(isDirectX)
                {
                                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                                                projectionMatrix[2, i] = projectionMatrix[2, i] * 0.5f + projectionMatrix[3, i] * 0.5f;
                                }
                }
                Shader.SetGlobalMatrix("_CustomProjMatrix", projectionMatrix);
}[/code]
Now, let's look at the benefits of this approach:
[list]
[*]Super cheap, only performance impact is a tiny vertex shader change[/*]
[*]Works on any shader as long as we add the "FIRST_PERSON" shader feature into it (one line of code)[/*]
[*]The FoV of the gun is always completely independent of the camera FoV[/*]
[*]First-Person models don't need any hacks to work with post-processing. They're all rendered on the main camera.[/*]
[*]Everything casts shadows properly[/*]
[*]Everything receives shadows properly (and looks a lot less 'floaty')[/*]
[/list]
So, it's definitely a win. Also, something that could've technically been done in DTO v1 was the FoV of the first-person camera changed to be smaller, which really makes it look like a proper FPS:
New
[img=http://i.imgur.com/Inil9FK.png][/img]
Old
[img=http://i.imgur.com/r45RFrr.png][/img]
 
Stay up to date on Twitter for more devblogs [url=http://twitter.com/downtoonegame]@DownToOneGame.[/url]
:dtoDanger:

notes.title: Update 1.2.1 and new Weekly Cup!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Today's minor patch fixes a few issues reported after yesterday's big 1.2 update, thanks to all those who reported them! 

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Fixed F4/third person spectator mode always rendering the players gun
    [*]Fixed movement animations not syncing
    [*]Fixed loss of Post-Processing when swapping through players in spectator mode
    [*]Fixed a bug which caused your body to be rendered in a weird position when spectating someone who moved close to your body
    [*]Slightly reduced ambient light intensity
    [*]Fixed on-hit effects not applying, and reduced brightness of desaturation effect
    [*]Fixed smoke grenades being permanent
    [*]Fixed animation sync bug with snakes
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7604361/f8da3f2c2e876c825ac33af35e61ba22f71d930e.jpg[/img]
[b]Weekly Cup - Power Plays[/b]
With a new update, comes a new weekly cup. Will the swathe of balance changes in DTO v1.2 dethrone the previous pros, or will we see Poncho continue his dominance? Anyone can play in the Down To One weekly cup, so if you want to give it a try, come on down! We'll be kicking off the weekly cup with a warmup round this week, followed by the final, with 25 DTO Steam keys to be won in prizes!

[b]When is the tournament?[/b]

This tournament will be held at 8:30pm AWST (GMT+8) this Friday, the 23rd of March. players should be ready 5 minutes before the allocated start time. Check [url=http://www.timeanddate.com/countdown/generic?iso=20160624T2030&p0=196&msg=Down+To+One+1.2+Update+Cup&ud=1&font=serif]here[/url] for a countdown clock.

As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url] for all the latest news and updates!

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Civil Engineering
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/NOqcgJh.png [/img]
 [h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

It's time for the update you've all been waiting for! DTO v1.2 is without a doubt our biggest update yet, seeing full reworks to in-game visuals, performance, stats, an engine update, and plenty more.

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Rendering rework
-Previously, Down To One used a custom rendering setup to overcome a number of issues within Unity 4, and also made things like "hands-over-UI" possible. Since DTO is now running on the Unity 5.4 beta, we've been able to get rid of most of this custom, hacky code and replace it with cleaner, shorter methods that lead to less bugs, higher performance, and better visuals.
    [*]New PostFX
-Post-Processing isn't a term that everyone thinks of fondly, but DTO's newly updated PostFX pipeline, PRISM, has been built specifically for performance, and outperforms any other Post-Processing system for Unity by up to 500%. Not only that, but our new PostFX also get applied to the first-person camera thanks to the rendering rework, meaning that your characters hands + gun no longer look out of place.
    [*]Reworked visuals
-New textures, shaders, and color correction all add to the new Down To One experience. Add custom reflection maps for each area on the map, improved shadows, and no more occlusion culling bugs, and DTO has never looked so good.
    [*]Reworked ADS
-Previously, ADSing in Down To One 'glued' the camera to the gun, which meant that recoil when ADSing was not very visual. Our new ADS rework not only fixes this, but also gives certain guns different ironsight positions to better correlate with how your character would actually look down the sights.
    [*]Introducing the MP40
-A new patch wouldn't be perfect without a new gun, so the MP40 has started to appear in various military outposts & watch towers in Down To One. Firing slower than all other SMGs, but with very controllable recoil, and slightly higher accuracy, the MP40's 32-round 9mm magazine is a solid choice for close to mid range combat.    
     [*]Reset perks, cash and stats
-With update 1.2, the 'season' has been reset, so everyone starts out again on a level playing field. 
     [*]New perk - "Build A Wall" (Cost: 15 Perk Points)
-Your skills in border protection allow you to solidify the Playable Area for 60 seconds, turning it into an impassable wall and increasing damage dealt to anyone caught outside it for the duration. 
     [*]Various major performance improvements
 [/list]

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Improved Main Menu visuals
    [*]Added end-game effect to transition out before the main menu
    [*]Increased reward on the High Roller perk to 500% (from 300%)
    [*]Decreased health bonus on the Armor Plates perk to 15 (from 20)
    [*]Buffed Demolition Expert perk extra damage by 100%
    [*]Changed the playable area so that it decreases slower at the start of the round - this should let players have a bit more of an 'exploration' phase before transitioning into combat, as well as increasing average round time
    [*]Various main menu bugfixes
    [*]Fixed stats not saving correctly
    [*]Various ingame bugfixes
    [*]Various changes to scale of objects 
    [*]Server stability improvements 
 
So, as you can see, it's been worth the wait - don't waste any time, get out onto the battlefield and get ranking up again! Also, something we also wanted to get into this update is DX12 support, which unfortunately is still broken in Unity - as soon as it works, we'll ship it! As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url], and if you'd like Steam notifications for when matches are starting, don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

notes.title: Weekly Cup 50 - The Big Five-O
notes.content:
[img]http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1458739101.png[/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

This week, we've got some great news for players who have been eager to jump back into the action in Deathmatch - a new dedicated Doda Deathmatch server has been setup on our NA box, so you can practice your shooting skills and jump into the action easily! 

[b]Weekly Cup 50 - The Big Five-O[/b]
It's time for our biggest weekly cup yet, as we celebrate 50 weeks of competitive Down To One action and end the first season with a bang. With [b]$100 cash[/b] and $50 in keys to be won, it's time to get your practice face on and gear up for the 50th Down To One weekly cup. Anyone can play in the Down To One weekly cup, and anyone can win! We'll be kicking off the weekly cup with a warmup round this week, followed by the final. For more info, check out the news post on our website [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/58/weekly-cup-50-the-big-five-o]here.[/url]

[b]Update 1.2[/b]
We're still waiting on a stable build of Unity 5.4 to come out before our next update, which aims to give a massive boost in performance by utilizing DirectX12. Currently, Unity have delayed the release of Unity 5.4, which is currently a very buggy and unstable beta. We'll keep everyone up to date on twitter, so stay tuned!

As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url], and if you'd like Steam notifications for when custom events like the Weekly Cup are starting, don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Perks 'A' Plenty
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KzT9zlV.png[/img]
 [h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch is one of our biggest yet, featuring 3 new perks, plenty of optimizations, bugfixes, balance changes, improvements to spectator mode, the UI, and more!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Added new perk - "Armor Plates" (Cost: 20 Perk Points/$50k)
-In an all-new 20 perk point cost tier, Armor Plates equips your player with ceramic armor plates, which give an extra 20HP worth of protection from damage before they wear out. This perk has a very high risk/reward factor - if you lose the extra health early on in the round, there is no way to recover it!
    [*]Added new perk - "Squats" (Cost: 5 Perk Points/$5k)
-After intense training, your crouching speed is improved by 15%
    [*]Added new perk - "Double Agent" (Cost: 5 Perk Points/$5k)
-Radios cannot detect you, and your position on the in-game map is scrambled
    [*]Increased radio spawn rate in many military spawners
    [*]Nerfed flare bombardment duration by 13 seconds, down to 7 seconds
    [*]Improved spectator freecam movement
    [*]Removed one unmarked minefield near the Old Airfield
    [*]Improved some food item icons 
    [*]The server browser now shows more up-to-date information, and not show servers that have already ended
    [*]Added server hosting readme
    [*]Rebalanced ELO rating rank requirements
    [*]Added new bush rustle sounds
    [*]Added new helicopter flyby sound
    [*]Hands now render under the UI by default
    [*]The playable area no longer clips at long distances from the camera
    [*]Added French translation to the main menu (thanks [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Adamyus/]Adamyus![/url]
    [*]You can now see players current weapon & weapon stats when spectating them
    [*]Added new "Throw Item" button (G by default)
-Useful if you're teaming up and need to throw an item over a long distance to a friend, thrown items do not deal damage
    [*]Added new playable area chat notification when it appears
-This change should remind players in houses/without vision on the playable area to get outside and check
    [*]Nerfed "Healthy" perk health regen amount by 25%
-The Healthy perk has always been a bit too strong, and recent nerfs to playable area damage meant that it would let a player perma-tank the playable area. This change should fix that.
    [*]Decreased most Military area spawner maximum spawns
    [*]Decreased bloodbag spawn rate in medical and residential spawners
    [*]Added new easy-start tick if a server does not start for a while
    [*]Added !perks command (works in specator mode as well)
    [*]Made the Southern Farm more lush
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Improved rendering performance
    [*]Removed blue bars on some aspect ratios/resolutions in the menus
    [*]Fixed mines being invisible to late joiners
    [*]Fixed performance issue as more players died
    [*]Fixed infinite loop when faking death & gesturing
    [*]Player ragdolls should now correctly fall off a ladder if they die
    [*]Fixed sniper tower floating loot
    [*]Fixed ELO showing as provisional when it shouldn't
    [*]Fixed issue which could cause negative cash
    [*]Fixed some translation errors
    [*]Fixed some AI bugs related to weapon pickups & firing
    [*]Optimized physics layers
    [*]Fixed carepackage chopper spawning in at 0,0,0 for one frame
    [*]Refactored some playable area related code that could cause it to collide with non-player objects. This should fix quite a few playable area bugs.

 [b] Weekly Cup 45[/b]
Stay tuned for an announcement later this week with all the info on our 45th DTO weekly cup! You can catch up on the highlight from last weeks cup over on our YouTube channel [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=byZLMiuO7dg]here![/url]
 
As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url], and if you'd like Steam notifications for when matches are starting, don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

notes.title: Weekly Cup 43 and new Featured Region - Australia
notes.content:
[img]http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1453895663.png[/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

This week's featured region has come at a great time, with Australia Day yesterday, what better way to celebrate than to get some all-new Australian servers! For the course of the week, this will grant any player double rewards and experience for playing on any official server in the region.

Since launch, we've always wanted to have some Aussie servers, and (since the game is actually being developed from Australia), this is a great opportunity for our Australian community to grow! So, tell your mates to chuck a U-E, crack open a tinny, throw a few snags on the barby and jump in-game for a few cracker rounds on the new servers!

[b]Update 1.1[/b]
Now that everything's looking nice and smooth, we're taking our time to create a [i]massive[/i] post-launch update, which will hit early next month when ready. This gives us a chance to really break things, add new cool content, and sufficiently test the update before we push it out to everyone. Stay tuned  to our [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url] for update teasers!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Need For Speed
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/Uu2t4FU.png [/img]
 [h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch introduces a raft of improvements, bugfixes, and most importantly, optimizations - thanks to everyone who's found a new bug in the last week!

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Default maximum late-join time now set to 120 seconds
    [*]Added in camera fade on spawn
    [*]Updated Antihack and global ban lists
    [*]Improved VOIP performance by up to 20x in some scenarios
    [*]Re-enabled VOIP on lower quality levels by default
    [*]Improved character movement to remove micro-stutters
    [*]Added in limits to viewing angles when climbing ladder 
    [*]Removed some annoying, useless notification messages, and moved some notifications to chat
    [*]Added alternate server browser as a fall-back option
    [*]Improved knife textures
    [*]Flares last 10 seconds shorter, but are now more common in low military spawners
    [*]The Uzi now has a chance to spawn at the weapons crate drop
    [*]The Radio will now spawn in military areas, offering valuable intel on a nearby primary weapon, then intel on a nearby player for a cost of $4k/$8k
    [*]Decreased high-grade food (MREs/Rations) spawn rate in residential spawners
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Various player-related optimizations
    [*]Added more robust checks to handle edge cases in interactions, like picking up drawers
    [*]Fixed VOIP settings not being respected
    [*]Fixed soccer ball not replicating across the network
    [*]Fixed AI sometimes spawning when they shouldn't
    [*]Reduced Main Menu initial lag and freezes

notes.title: Down To 1.0
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/6XMhY3N.png [/img]
 [h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

[b]40[/b] Weekly tournaments.
[b]Over 100[/b] updates.
[b]Thousands[/b] of rounds played.
Still [b]No Zombies[/b].

The time has finally arrived! After 3 Release Candidates (RC1, RC2, and RC3) over the last week, Down To One has reached 1.0, and with the help of everyone who's supported it during our 11 months in Early Access, is now feature-complete and playing the best it ever has. Our goal at the start of Down To One's development was to create a [b]competitive[/b] survival game with [b]no zombies[/b], and you can take a look at the success of our weekly cups as a testament to how well that's turned out.

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KmLiM5gFcWk]Check out our Launch Trailer[/url][/b]

[b]What about the future?[/b]
[b]Our top focus right now is optimization - expect a patch next week (or even this weekend)[/b]
This question is bound to pop up, so let's get it out of the way. 1.0 for Down To One marks a point where the game is feature complete, optimization has improved dramatically since launch, and everything is playing well. The Down To One weekly cup will still continue, and we'll continue to support the game with patches for as long as possible, and of course, keeping our top-tier dedicated servers up and running as we have since launch on Early Access. 

[b]New Price Point[/b]
With 1.0 comes our new permanent price of $0.99, which should help keep a steady trickle of new players in. As we promised during Early Access, Down To One will never have any P2W microtransactions in it, and will never be F2P. You pay once, you get to play Down To One forever, simple as that.

[b]Real community-driven development[/b]
One of the things that we promised Down To One would have at the beginning of Early Access was community-driven development. This has absolutely been one of the most important aspects of development, without our community (particularly the regulars - you know who you are), Down To One would simply be less fun without your input, bugreports, suggestions, and general activity. So, a [b]huge thanks[/b] to all those who are still hanging around after 11 months of Early Access ːdtoDangerː

[b]Want to host your own DTO server?[/b]
In case you missed it, a while ago we partnered up with the great folks over at [url=https://uhostpro.com/downtooneinfo/]uHostPro[/url] to offer excellent server hosting & great support. If you want to host a custom Down To One server (or a bunch of other gameservers), check them out!

Of course, there's a couple of final changes and bugfixes for today's patch as well:

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Slightly reduced playable area damage per tick
-The tick damage of the playable area was just a bit too high, this change brings it in line with other survival-related damage ticks 
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Fixed rare main menu loading screen loop
    [*]Fixed radio giving incorrect heading data
    [*]Increased vertical speed threshold at which jump damage ticks up
    [*]Heavily optimized bandwidth usage 

 [b] Weekly Cup 40 - Faceoff[/b]
[img] http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1451985249.png [/img]
It's a special weekly cup this week as we jump into our 40th cup since launch. We've come a long way since then, and to celebrate, this weeks weekly cup will feature [b]DOUBLE PRIZES[/b] - don't miss it! For more info, check out the news post on our website [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/48/weekly-cup-40-faceoff/]here.[/url]
 
As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url], and if you'd like Steam notifications for when matches are starting, don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

notes.content:

 [h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

notes.title: Update 0.9.4 RC1 - New Years Cheer!
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/6zZHcBp.png [/img]
 [h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight, we've got another massive patch with a bunch of bugfixes, including some big improvements to wall clipping and player movement!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Improved Anticheat detection capabilities
     [*]Improved player movement 
-Player movement now feels less "floaty", and has more inertia attached to it, whilst still being responsive.
     [*]Added in new anti-wallclip mechanic
     [*]Removed "Host Server" button in main menu 
-All server hosting can now be done using custom launch arguments, ask us how if you'd like to host your own custom server
     [*]Added description for Deathmatch gamemode in the Server Browser
     [*]Decreased thirst damage per tick by 15%
-This change should help open up more valuable perk options and inventory arrangements by reducing the effect dehydration has on your character
     [*]Added playable area warning message in chat
     [*]Improved sniper ADS sensitivity 
     [*]Improved Grenade throw message
     [*]The playable area will decrease faster when only 2 players are remaining 
     [*]Tripled NVG event spawn chance modifier in nightmode
     [*]Happy new year, all hotzones will now create fireworks :)
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Fixed clients "winning" twice after a round ends
    [*]Fixed playable area in Deathmatch not applying damage ticks
    [*]Scoreboard now correctly shows up in Deathmatch mode
    [*]Items no longer disappear if you join deathmatch mode after the round starts
    [*]Really fixed Vsync setting not being respected, and fixed VSync locking to 30fps
    [*]Fixed a bug related to server restarting
    [*]Improved Terrain performance
    [*]Fixed a bug which could cause your opponent to not always drop their gun if you shot it out of their hands
    [*]Fixed a bug related to item counts
    [*]Decreased NVG sound level
    [*]Fixed nightmode brightness
    [*]Improved play-dead perk position after death
    [*]Fixed thirst/hunger messages from playing in spectator mode
    [*]Various AI fixes
    [*]Various other round-related fixes
 [/list]

 [b] Weekly Cup 39[/b]
It's time to jump into the action for another Down To One weekly cup tonight! With a $100 prizepool, anyone can play, and anyone can win. For more info, check out the news post on our website [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/47/weekly-cup-39-fireworks/]here.[/url]

notes.title: Update 0.9.2 - Optimizations -A-Plenty!
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/iiBNwo1.png [/img]
 [h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight, we've got an optimization-focused patch in store for everyone. As well as reducing CPU workload, we've also got some back-end improvements to our netcode, in our quest for the best competitive netcode of any FPS. Game on!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Increased network sendrates & improved prioritization system
     [*]Added new descriptive interact icon, instead of "!"
     [*]When in spectator mode, you no longer see the annoying desaturation effect of the player that you're spectating
     [*]Improved appearance of various particle systems (smoke grenade, carepackage)
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Swapping between 1st/3rd person spectator mode now works again
    [*]Improved particle system performance
    [*]Improved physics performance
    [*]Improved various animator-related performance issues
    [*]The server now restarts/ends the round properly if AI are the only players alive
    [*]Fixed Vsync setting not being respected
    [*]Fixed bug which could cause the server & spectator mode to lag if you joined the round late/rejoined the match
 [/list]
 [b] Weekly Cup 39[/b]
This week's weekly cup will not be played on Friday, we'll be wishing everyone a merry Christmas instead! Once we've finalized a time for the next weekly cup, it'll be posted as an article on our website [url=http://downtoonegame.com/]here.[/url] (Potentially early next week, if not, definitely next Friday)

As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url], and if you'd like Steam notifications for when matches are starting, don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

notes.title: Update 0.9.0 - Spit 'n' Polish
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/V7qEaLO.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight, we've got one of our biggest patches to date, with a raft of improvements to gunplay, graphics, settings, menus, bugfixes, optimizations, and more!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Added ELO ranking system
-ELO is now distributed to all players at the end of a round, and your ELO ranking & current rank can be viewed from the "Perks and Customization" screen
    [*]Optimized performance as amount of players increases 
-Previously, all player animators and IK ran every frame, regardless of how far away they were from you, or whether they were even on-screen. This change should help CPU-limited systems.
    [*]Player avatar picture in the "Perks and Customization" screen now grabs your Steam avatar
    [*]Added in-game basic settings options
    [*]Left-click now throws a rock/other throwable item that you're holding
    [*]Menu UI no longer pops up after death in a round
    [*]Local footstep sounds (from your player) are now softer
     [*]Added new accuracy penalty for moving whilst shooting
-This penalty is multiplicative, and based off the guns natural ADS accuracy. For instance, snipers are affected much more from this change than guns like the Vityaz.
     [*]New accuracy penalty for shooting when out of stamina
-This adds a bit of risk to the "bunnyhop" gunfight style
     [*]Grenades now display a message showing how far away from you they've landed
     [*]Grenades now have stickier physics materials,
-This makes it easier to predict where your grenade will stop moving, previously they could bounce anywhere
     [*]Added "Join Featured Server" button directly to the Main Menu
    [*]Increased level of Eye Adaptation
    [*]Caps lock is now the rebindable button to bring up the scoreboard in Deathmatch mode
    [*]Improved Perk Selection UI, and added helpful messages
    [*]Decreased time between dying and going into spectator mode
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Optimized "Potato" quality CPU performance
    [*]Fixed super-lag spike when the anti-wall-peek effect triggered
    [*]Fixed some settings not saving correctly
    [*]Fog no longer affects visibility of the Playable Area dome
    [*]Various stamina system bugfixes
    [*]Improved Fist hitdetection
    [*]Various AI improvements
    [*]Fixed overexposure
    [*]Decreased aggressive culling distance at the U.S. Base
    [*]Decreased pop-in on lower graphics settings
    [*]Fixed sway on the C36G
 [/list]

[img]http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1450235536.png [/img]
[b] Weekly Cup 38 - Double Down[/b]
This weeks weekly cup will be played on the 0.9 update, and as per usual, anyone can play! For more info on prizes, rules, and everything else, check out the news post on our website [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/46/weekly-cup-38-double-down/]here.[/url]

As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url], and if you'd like Steam notifications for when matches are starting, don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/a2xDc3q.png[/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Hate snipers? You'll love tonight's patch, which adds in an all new scope sway & breath holding mechanic. As well as that, we've got a bunch of bugfixes and optimizations in store for everyone.

    [*]Added scope sway

    [*]Added 'Hold Breath' mechanic

    [*]Improved SSAO visuals 
    [*]Slightly decreased base brightness in day mode
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Reduced microstutters & garbage collection allocations
    [*]Reworked Foot IK, now the character correctly places their feet when standing, running, and crouched
-This change also improves the general look of our movement animations
    [*]Optimized SSAO
    [*]Optimized Bloom
    [*]NVG Events no longer occur when in daymode

notes.title: Update 0.7.8 - Night Operations
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/gLpuXvD.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

It's time to stick to the shadows in our latest update, as night mode arrives in Down To One! With a new atmospheric setting, lower visibility, and the new Night-Vision Goggles, you'll have to adapt your playstyle to suit this new mode, which will be rolling out on all non-deathmatch servers until the next patch.

notes.content:

[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's update sees a bunch of major optimizations introduced into Down To One - including the introduction of PRISM FX, our new post-processing pipeline that has been built from the ground-up for performance!

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]

    [*]Replaced image effect pipeline with PRISM FX
-New Depth of Field effect
-New Vignette effect
-New Tonemapping
-New Color Correction effect

    [*]Optimized & multi-threaded particle performance

notes.title: Update 0.7.4 - Doda Deathmatch
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/1Ldn299.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's update adds in a brand new gamemode - 'Doda Deathmatch!' On top of that, we've got plenty of bugfixes and usability improvements on the way as well.

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Added new 'Doda Deathmatch' gamemode
-Rounds last 10 minutes by default
-Players can join any time throughout the round, and rounds can start with 2 or more players
-The winner is the player with the most kills at the end of the round
-A selection of weapons can be picked up in the spawn area - you choose what gun to fight with!
-This new gamemode uses an all-new, optimized version of the map (with less areas on it, of course) - enjoy higher FPS in this mode!
    [*]Moved preloading spike to after the main menu scene has been rendered
-We are working with our 3rd party networking middleware vendor, Bolt, to get a fix for this slight freeze on initial startup
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Terrain now uses the default Unity terrain shader if the graphics card reports the main terrain shader as not supported
    [*]Fixed wacky ragdolls
    [*]Fixed bug which could cause you to not take damage when low on food/water (thanks FooFoo)
    [*]Guns should never dissappear in spectator mode now 
    [*]Fixed AI navmesh never loading
    [*]Fixed some rock collision boxes
 [/list]

notes.title: Update 0.7.0 - Introducing the UZI
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/Qm5XqCz.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight we've got a pretty big patch lined up, with a new weapon, big improvements to AI, graphics, performance - and of course, plenty of bugfixes!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Added the UZI Personal Defence Weapon
-Firing 9mm box rounds, the UZI is an effective close-quarters primary weapon. With a very controllable 600RPM rate of fire, and a higher effective range than the Vityaz, the UZI is a solid choice for short range combat.
-The UZI has a high spawn rate in guard towers & at the Old Airfield
    [*]Added the UZI mag
    [*]Decreased snake health damage amount by 50%
    [*]Improved grassy terrain textures
    [*]The playable area now can only move a maximum of 100 units per tick (previously it was moving >200 on a bad decrease)
    [*]Reduced adrenaline spawnrate in medical spawners
    [*]Weapons can now spawn in worse condition
    [*]Moved AI over to new character model & animations
    [*]Influence events (eg. "Russian weapons have arrived in x") are now a LOT more potent
    [*]Rocks from explosions can now hit & hurt you if travelling at a high enough velocity
    [*]Painkillers now restore health over time, as opposed to instantly
    [*]Reenabled fog at some higher quality settings
    [*]Nerfed MK16 hipfire accuracy by 50%
-Previously, the MK16 was almost always a better choice than the M4, due to lower recoil, and higher general accuracy. 
    [*]Improved Depth of Field effect so that it actually applies depth of field
-It's almost worth paying 3ms/frame for now!
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Various explosion shader optimizations (performance, visuals)
    [*]Fixed AK holding animation
    [*]Fixed GIF-spam in chat when recording a GIF
    [*]Fixed Animation blending artifacts on lowest graphics settings
    [*]Tons of AI fixes and improvements (pathfinding, looting, behaviour, combat)
    [*]Fixed missing polys on a few houses around the map
 [/list]

-The UZI has a high spawn rate in guard towers & at the Old Airfield
    [*]Added the UZI mag
    [*]Decreased snake health damage amount by 50%
    [*]Improved grassy terrain textures
    [*]The playable area now can only move a maximum of 100 units per tick (previously it was moving >200 on a bad decrease)
    [*]Reduced adrenaline spawnrate in medical spawners
    [*]Weapons can now spawn in worse condition
    [*]Moved AI over to new character model & animations
    [*]Influence events (eg. "Russian weapons have arrived in x") are now a LOT more potent
    [*]Rocks from explosions can now hit & hurt you if travelling at a high enough velocity
    [*]Painkillers now restore health over time, as opposed to instantly
    [*]Reenabled fog at some higher quality settings
    [*]Nerfed MK16 hipfire accuracy by 50%
-Previously, the MK16 was almost always a better choice than the M4, due to lower recoil, and higher general accuracy. 
    [*]Improved Depth of Field effect so that it actually applies depth of field

[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

For our second update in "Gun Week", the G18 is making its appearance in Down To One. With the most recoil of any gun in the game when firing in fully-automatic, it's sure to test your reflexes!
On top of that, we've got a big nerf to snakes, that should move them into more of a "pest" role, as opposed to their current "more dangerous than a player with a melee weapon" role :) Oh, and now you can record GIFs with the click of a button!

Read on for the full patch notes.

[list] 
    [*]Added the G18 Pistol
-Firing 9mm rounds, the G18 is the first selectable fire-mode pistol in Down To One. When set to full auto, it will fire its 17-bullet clip at a blazing fast 1100 RPM, although with a steep damage dropoff and uncontrollable recoil, you will need to be up close to your enemy.
    [*]Added the G18 Mag
    [*]Decreased snake health damage amount by 50%
    [*]Increased size of snake hitboxes
    [*]Decreased snake health by 25%
    [*]Increased snake thirst damage amount by 2
    [*]Decreased snake movement speed

 [/list]

    [*]Added in a potential fix for the positions of items being incorrect on clients that have joined the game late

    [*]Improved start-up time
    [*]Re-enabled static batching (optimization)

notes.title: Update 0.6.6 - Spring Cleaning
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RwmaUXY.png[/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's update adds in a ton of new improvements & fixes, and introduces an "exploration" variation gamemode for practice servers!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Added "Explore" mode for practice servers
-Ever wanted just to explore the map, and get to learn the best loot spots without worrying about the playable area or hunger & thirst? Explore mode stops the playable area from decreasing, and your hunger and thirst levels decrease significantly slower.
    [*]Various small tonemapping & bloom visual improvements and optimizations
    [*]Increased light range on mines
    [*]The "Play Dead" perk now looks a little bit more convincing
    [*]Increased max item spawn amount in some residential spawners
    [*]Decreased delay between spawns in some residential spawners
    [*]More ladder improvements (they are actually a lot easier to get onto now)
    [*]The weapons crate chopper now drops at a much more reliable time in the round - from 3-6 minutes in (down from 3-10)
    [*]Clamped playable area maximum movement speed, to prevent some of the super fast decreases
    [*]Added more snakes to practice mode
    [*]Added warning pole to minefield near old airfield
    [*]Server admins can now live-ban players
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed laser/smoke signal on the playable area from not reaching the ground sometimes
    [*]Fixed "Grid of dots" when running on low with an AMD GPU
    [*]Anti-wallclip mechanic now works more reliably
    [*]Fixed "You can rejoin the server...." message from getting spammed incorrectly
    [*]Fixed inventory keybinds still accepting input whilst chatting
    [*]Fixed thrown grenades disappearing after 3 metres
    [*]Changed the way batching works in Down To One, to use dynamic instead of static batching
-Previously, static batching was causing large portions of the map to be redrawn when they didn't really need to be. In theory this change should improve performance, but let us know what your FPS is now, and whether you've seen an improvement after this patch!
    [*]Snakes are now less likely to glitch up to you
    [*]Fixed in-game menu scaling issues at different aspect ratios
    [*]Morrrrrrre AI pathfinding changes
 [/list]

[img] http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1442235277.png [/img]
[b]Weekly Cup #26[/b]
This Friday, the 26th weekly Down To One cup will be kicking off, don't miss your chance to play, and win some great prizes! [url=httphttp://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/Unknown/33/weekly-cup-26-lets-dance]Check out the news post here for more info. [/url]

notes.content:

[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonigh's update sees some changes to the playable area, improvements to audio, and more!

    [*]Added red smoke signal to show where the playable area is moving towards

    [*]Made ladders easier to interact with/climb

    [*]Added notification to let players know when they can rejoin a server to continue playing
 [/list]

    [*]Fixed a bug that let you run whilst bloodbagging

notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/xRG6kue.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Today's update introduces the Blood Bag, sees some changes to the playable area, AI, and more!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Added the Blood Bag
- The Blood Bag is a rare medical item that can be used to restore a large portion of health, although takes quite a while to apply - be careful you're in cover when using it!

    [*]Added new "Guard Tower" military spawner type, which makes guard towers more likely to spawn primary weapons 
 [/list]

notes.title: Update 0.6 - New Beginnings
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/01cHwgu.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

You've been waiting, and it's finally here - Down To One update 0.6 is our biggest update yet, and we're super excited to finally show it off to everyone. What's in 0.6? Well, here's a quick rundown:

[b]Full Animation Rework[/b]
Up until now, we've had some pretty terrible placeholder animations, and tonight's update finally gets rid of them. Down To One has over 100 character animations, and [i]every single one[/i] of those animations has been re-done from scratch for update 0.6. Karl has done a [url=http://www.gadget-games.com/files/videos/newcrouchwalkdirectional.mp4]fantastic[/url] job with the rework, and as well as the animations, our character has had a re-rig and visual upgrade.

[b]Trading Cards[/b]
You asked, we listened! Down To One now has trading cards, and some really cool badges & emotes as well. 

[b]New Player Experience[/b]
Have you ever asked, or seen someone ask questions like "why am I taking damage?", "am I thirsty?", "where does the playable area end?"? Well, tonight's patch adds in plenty of handy mechanics to make things a lot clearer for all new players, without being obnoxious. We'll also be doing a Steam weekly deal sale within the next two weeks, so stay tuned for that!

[b]Performance[/b]
Early testing on update 0.6 has shown us some very promising performance numbers, so if you've been struggling to play before, tonight might be the perfect update to jump back in on. Let us know how your performance is!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Reworked all animations
    [*]Reworked animator controller & many other aspects of the animation & IK setup
    [*]Improved character model & character skinning 
    [*]Implemented new LODs on all weapons and some props 
    [*]Added Vignette effect, which triggers when some types of damage (eg. playable area, food, water) are taken 
    [*]Item tooltips now popup by default after picking up an item 
    [*]Increased duration of item tooltip popup
    [*]Added new playable area decrease notification
    [*]Music now ducks in volume when you enter a building 
    [*]Improved L96 textures 
    [*]Added the "Stabilize" perk
-Stabilize greatly reduces the impact of all camera shakes 
    [*]Spectator controls are now rebindable from the launcher (thanks Yester) 
    [*]Added Steam trading cards
    [*]AI now use the built-in Navmesh system, get stuck less, and no longer go through any walls at spawn 
    [*]Damage applied to feet has been reduced to 30% of normal damage
    [*]Damage applied to hands has been reduced to 80% (from 90%) of normal damage  
    [*]Improved ambient lighting in-game 
    [*]The Vityaz is now slightly more inaccurate when hip firing 
    [*]Added notification when you start/stop bleeding 
    [*]Added notification for when the Glutton perk effect is applied
    [*]Added notification for when the Thirst Quencher perk effect is applied
    [*]Added notification for when the 'Ol Western perk effect is applied
    [*]Added notification when you become dehydrated/starving 
    [*]Buffed snake movement speed
-#SNAKESOP 
    [*]Decreased L96 firerate 
    [*]The Main Menu now has capped FPS  
    [*]Reduced network traffic/data usage 
    [*]You can now see inventories in spectator mode 
    [*]Added new "Bug Report" window in the Main Menu 
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improved bird animations & performance
    [*]Reduced movement stutter on AI
    [*]Fixed age-old bug where if you joined after a round had started, your client would not know about any items on the map, or in players hands ('invisible gun' bug)
    [*]Fixed players not 'dying' properly when using the Healthy perk
    [*]Reduced GPU memory usage
    [*]21:9 aspect ratio is now supported in-game
    [*]Fixed issue which could cause the first-person camera to render two passes per frame
    [*]Fixed issue which could cause the player to move extremely slowly after performing an action
    [*]Added !fixpickup command
    [*]Fixed bug which caused your dead body to not render correctly in spectator mode
    [*]Sunshafts now actually work properly
-Check them out at the Old Airfield hangars!
    [*]Reduced network stutter & garbage collection
    [*]Fixed issue with some environmental props not spawning
    [*]Fixed Server Browser taking a large amount of time after reconnecting
    [*]Various other performance improvements
 [/list]

[img] http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1441109417.png [/img]
[b]Weekly Cup #24[/b]
This week, the 24th weekly Down To One cup will be kicking off on Friday, don't miss your chance to play, and win some great prizes! [url= http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/Unknown/31/weekly-cup-24-spring-has-sprung]Check out the news post here for more info. [/url] 

As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url], and if you'd like Steam notifications for when matches are starting, don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

We'll see you in-game!

notes.content:
[img] http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1439266058.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's we've got a minor update to bridge the gap between now and update 0.6, with some core audio changes to gunshots, and a new community requested feature.
 
Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added "Reset Perks" button (thanks Poncho for suggesting this)
-Now you can reset your perks, and pick 2x 15 perk point cost perks, leaving your third slot empty.
    [*]Improved texture compression settings to reduce GPU memory & RAM usage.
    [*]Refactored gunshot audio
-Now "spreads" over distance
-Sounds out to a much further distance than before (distant shots will actually be heard)
-Gun handling sounds no longer play to the same distance as gunshots 
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improved performance of all explosions 
 [/list]

notes.title: Update 0.56 - Hop, Skip & Jump
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/B4Zs2aT.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch adds some important AI & player movement changes, map improvements, and plenty of bugfixes!
 
Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]AI now use an "Island Hopping" technique to pathfind
-Previously, AI were often getting 'stuck' when trying to find a path over the entire map (up to 2km). This change should help increase the success of AI pathfinding.
    [*]Updated Flare description to reflect its new use for calling in aerial strikes
    [*]Reworked player movement control when falling/jumping 
    [*]Decreased backwards movespeed by 5%
    [*]Fall damage now has a higher base damage, but requires a larger impact to trigger
    [*]Added warning sign to the minefield near the Old Airfield
    [*]Added new EU-North server 
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Item crosshair now shows on Hardcore (no crosshairs) mode
    [*]The in-game map no longer tracks dead players
    [*]Typing space into chat no longer makes the character jump after the message is sent
    [*]Changed chopper movement algorithm to better handle dropped updates (smoother)
    [*]Fixed spectator bug when spectating a player with a Red-Dot Sight
 [/list]

[img] http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1437476396.png [/img]

notes.title: Update 0.54 - Perks 'N' More
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/f6mF3le.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch sees some changes to Perks across the board, adds a new Perk, and a new gameplay mechanic related to the in-game map!
 
Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]The In-Game map will now show a (delayed) reading of how many players are in each area
-This mechanic should help create new objective-based play, by offering players a good incentive to stay mobile throughout the round
    [*]Decreased Glutton perk point cost by 10 
    [*]Decreased Thirst Quencher perk point cost by 10
    [*]Increased Binge perk point cost by 5
    [*]The Ninja Vanish perk now also stops dust from being kicked up when jumping
    [*]Increased the Defrag perk explosive damage reduction amount to 25% (from 15%)
    [*]Decreased Gun Maintenance perk point cost by 5
    [*]Increased SuperSonic perk point cost by 5
    [*]Added the High Roller perk - Earn 300% more cash from bets
    [*]Added an option in basic settings to Aim-Down-Sights by holding down your ADS key, instead of toggling it
    [*]Improved first-person character rendering on medium and above (reduced aliasing)
    [*]Holding Shift whilst setting a bet amount now adds or subtracts 5x the usual increment
    [*]Added the Red-Dot-Sight 12Ga. variant
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Doubled ragdoll weight - this should help make ragdolls a little bit less crazy
    [*]Fixed gun condition decrease not working on some guns
    [*]Added LOD levels to the sledgehammer
    [*]Fixed an issue from last Friday's 0.53 server-side patch that could sometimes cause more than one server instance to start
 [/list]

notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/YXm4kli.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch introduces the Sledgehammer, a heavy-hitting, slow-swinging melee weapon, some general improvements to melee combat, and more!
 
Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the Sledgehammer
    [*]Added 2 new routes that the weapons crate chopper can move & drop along
    [*]Melee hit impacts will now occur 100% of the time

notes.title: Update 0.5 - New Friends
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/iotqua8.png [/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

It's been cooking up for a while, and now it's finally here! Update 0.5 is probably our biggest update yet in terms of new features, content, and % of code changed. With the first implementation of our AI, Matchmaking, an In-game map, new weapons, and much more, we're pretty excited.
 
Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added initial AI Implementation
-For AI in Down To One, we wanted to get the core architecture right. Every AI in DTO has to loot weapons, food, water, bandages, stay inside the playable area, kill snakes, etc, and even aim properly. 
-AI also benefit from just about every passive perk they (or you) have - If you shoot a weapon in the AI's hands, it will get damaged, and become less accurate, or if an AI with the 'Ol Western perk hits your secondary, then it'll fly out of your hands, just like a player-shot bullet.
-Since this is our first implementation of AI, there are currently a few bugs which we'll be ironing out in the coming weeks, the most common/serious bug at the moment occurs when the AI cannot find a path to their desired location (you may notice the AI running through the spawn building this patch - that is the only building on the map that they will ever clip through). AI spawn after the round starts.
    [*]Added in-game map in the Spawn Area
    [*]Added Matchmaking (new button in the Main Menu)
    [*]Added bush sounds which trigger after moving in some foliage around the map
    [*]Added in-game video tutorials in the main menu
    [*]Added the 12 Gauge shotgun
-Holding up to 9 shells, the 12 Gauge is a very powerful close range weapon, which can also be loaded with either slugs, buckshot, or a combination of both.
    [*]Thrown flares now call in artillery shells to the area they land in
    [*]Increased flare spawn rate in military spawners
    [*]Tidied up in-game menu UI
    [*]Increased input polling rate for character movement
    [*]Updated Bolt networking to version 0.31 (various perf. increases)
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed bug where players who joined the game after the round had started would never receive information about weapons & other items (eg. invisible weapons in spectator mode) 
    [*]Fixed bug with the "Energized" perk not correctly applying the boost
    [*]Fixed game hanging on refreshing of server list
    [*]Various other networking-related bugfixes
 [/list]

[img]http://d1mt9jmphk9kik.cloudfront.net/downtoone/image1435670296.png[/img]
[b]Weekly Cup #15[/b]
This Friday, the 15th DTO weekly cup will be played on update 0.51 (scheduled for Thursday). Anyone can play - you don't even need to sign up - just turn up and play! [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/Unknown/22/weekly-cup-15-the-big-five-o]Check out the news post here for more info. [/url] 

As always, don't forget to follow Down To One on [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url], and if you'd like Steam notifications for when matches are starting, don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

notes.title: Update 0.49 - Edging Closer
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/p5T6m6j.png[/img]
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

As our last major patch before the [b]big[/b] 0.5 update, tonight we've got a round of bugfixes, some gunplay & character movement improvements, and balance tweaks packed in for everyone.

[b]0.5 Update:[/b]
Update 0.5 is scheduled to come out on Tuesday the 30th, set your clocks!
 
Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Decreased fall damage by 2 damage/tick (this is a ~15% nerf to fall damage)
    [*]Reduced time it takes to "ready" pistol after running
    [*]Further tweaked character movement, and increased input polling rate on movement
    [*]Increased spawn rate of water in some environmental spawners
    [*]Added jump land particle effect
    [*]Buffed smoke grenade area coverage and improved performance by up to 2x
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed perks not being selectable in the Main Menu 
    [*]Fixed bug with interaction crosshair coming up unintentionally
    [*]Improved hit detection, and added more accurate colliders to some environmental objects
    [*]Fixed bug which was causing the "Athletic" perk to not work (jump height perk)
 [/list]

[b]Update 0.5 News[/b]
Update 0.5 is just around the corner - and we're planning for it to be a very major update, with a raft of new features and improvements. As it's a much larger patch than normal, we're aiming to have it out by around mid next week. notes.title: Update 0.47 - Buzzing Around
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

As we head towards 0.5, tonight's update sees some performance improvements, an update to the new movement system, flies, and more!
 
Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improved movement code to rely much less on the normal vectr of the slope, and much more on user input to gauge direction
    [*]Added inertia to spectator mode camera (toggle with P)
    [*]Improved performance on "High" graphics settings 
    [*]The smoke grenade now covers a larger area
    [*]Going from walk>run now has a more natural acceleration
    [*]Bodies now attract flies
    [*]Increased Triple Barrel buckshot damage by 10%
    [*]Decreased Silenced 1911 spawnrate in residential spawners
    [*]Increased smoke grenade spawn rate in low military spawners
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed bug which caused fall damage to never apply 
    [*]Drinking and bandaging at the same time no longer bugs out (thanks MaxLene for the report)
    [*]Improved performance of all particle systems
    [*]Fixed rare bug that could cause some weapons to shoot with incorrect damage values
    [*]Fixed bug where late joiners were not affected by the playable area
     [*]Improved SSAO and reduced "ghosting" when aiming down sights
     [*]Fixed bug where using Adrenaline would cause the camera to stop rendering (yep...)
     [*]Fixed "Error in weapon script" from appearing & being spammed on the server
     [*]Improved wonky animation bug when placing mines (thanks FooFoo)
     [*]Fixed medical suitcase scaling
 [/list]

[b]Weekly Cup #13[/b]
Don't forget to check out our 13th weekly cup! Anyone can play - you don't even need to sign up - just turn up and play! [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/20/weekly-cup-13-shake-it-up]Check out the news post here for more info. [/url] 

[b]Community Translation[/b]
This week, we'd like to give a big shoutout to Toasterbrot, Stony Baboon, and BladeK, who are all helping to translate Down To One (and help make our UI clearer in the process).     [*]Increased Knife spawn rate in some spawners

notes.title: Update 0.4.4 - New Horizons
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight, we've got some graphical & map improvements, bugfixes, and two new silenced variants of the L96!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the silenced L96 (both scoped & ironsights)
-Dealing the same damage as the standard L96, the addition of a silencer slows down bullet velocity to 340m/sec, making targets harder to hit & penetrate at range
    [*]Improved character shaders & textures
    [*]Added new skybox 
    [*]Reworked explosions - now all explosions are calculated server-side, have a falloff range, and can now kill animals
    [*]Freecam in spectator mode now respects key bindings
    [*]Added UI popup when talking on VOIP
    [*]Decreased C36G spawns at the Old Airfield
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed LOD issue with the L96
    [*]Reduced VRAM usage 
    [*]Fixed bug which could cause the camera to bug out when reloading and aiming down sights
    [*]Fixed issue where the last bullet of a shotgun would always be buckshot
    [*]Fixed ladders on some houses in Doda not working
     [*]Fixed some stat-related bugs, stats should now save more reliably
     [*]Mine sounds no longer sound out to 500m
[/list]

[b]Weekly Cup #11[/b]
Don't forget to check out our 11th weekly cup! Anyone can play - you don't even need to sign up - just turn up and play! [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/18/weekly-cup-11-spray-n-pray]Check out the news post here for more info. [/url]

notes.title: Update 0.40 - Tread Lightly
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Update 0.4 brings in a huge host of changes, from gunplay, to environmental additions, spectator mode, large CPU optimizations and more!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added landmines
-Landmines detonate 1.5 seconds after being triggered by the player - although if you are fast enough with your hands, you can defuse the landmine before it explodes, and re-plant it anywhere you want
    [*]Added minefield near the US Base
-The US Base had little to no drawbacks as an initial location for players to head to. This change increases the risk of heading there, via the direct route.
    [*]Added minefield near & around the Old Airfield
-Combined with the current amount of snakes around the Old Airfield, the new Minefield should make players think twice before bee lining there at the start of each round
    [*]You can now grab large environmental objects (like fuel cans or vases) out of players hands
    [*]Added hip fire penalty - some guns will now have decreased accuracy when hip firing (for instance, guns like the Scout are hit hard by this nerf, although SMGs like the Vityaz are unaffected)
    [*]Added medical suitcases
-These suitcases should be found rarely in houses around the map, and will typically spawn high level medical loot
    [*]Added the "Demolition Expert" perk (5 perk points)
-Make any placed explosive (including mines) 200% more lethal with this new perk!
    [*]Improved Axe collision hitboxes
    [*]Playable area in Practice mode rebalanced, doesn't decrease as quickly now
    [*]New Freecam mode when spectating - use F1 (first person) and F4 (free cam) to switch
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Various large CPU optimizations
    [*]Fixed shovel hitboxes blocking interaction
    [*]Fixed incorrect placement of fabric on some houses in Doda
    [*]Added collision to some environmental objects that didn't have it
    [*]Dead birds now obey the laws of physics (they should now stop rolling after time)
     [*]Fixed HP Pistol & Scout UI text
 [/list]

[b]Weekly Cup #9[/b]
Tomorrow is our 9th weekly cup! Anyone can play, and anyone can win, for more details,  [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/Unknown/16/weekly-cup-9-explosions]check out the news post here. [/url]

notes.title: Update 0.38 - "Goodbye Jaggies"
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight, we've got some exciting graphical improvements to Down To One. With all new SMAA, and high quality eye adaptation, this patch is [i]looking[/i] pretty good!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added eye adaptation
-Using a similar histogram-based technique to that used in CryEngine & UE4, Down To One's new eye adaptation helps add to immersion when moving between darker & lighter areas
    [*]Added SMAA
-SMAA is now on by default on "High" graphics settings, and one of the best types of AntiAliasing available at the moment, smoothing 'jaggies', while keeping textures sharp 
    [*]Ammo in guns is no longer full by default, and is set relative to the guns condition on spawn
    [*]Increased the Triple Barrel's spread with slugs
    [*]Silent Step is no longer a default perk, replaced with Ninja Vanish
    [*]Decreased water spawn rate, and increased sports drink spawn rate 
-This is an overall nerf to available thirst-replenishing sources, as sports drink only restores 35 thirst (water: 40)
    [*]Balanced AK & AKM mag spawn rates
    [*]Muzzle flashes now emit light
    [*]Increased Triple Barrel spawn rate in high residential spawners
    [*]Increased time before round locks out players to 90 seconds (from 60)
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed FXAA making sunshafts not work properly
    [*]Fixed audio sometimes muting
    [*]Can no longer "Reload" fire extinguishers
    [*]Improved collision in spawn building
    [*]Improved CPU performance on low settings
    [*]Fixed buggy triple barrel reload
    [*]Can no longer "dance-crouch"
    [*]Fixed knife icon blurring at low settings
    [*]Fixed snake attack range bug
[/list]
