notes.title: Update 0.37 - It's Shovellin' Time!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

For tonight's patch, we've got a new weapon, improved snakes, [i]real[/i] positional audio, and tons of bugfixes & other improvements! 

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]The shovel can now be picked up & used as a weapon
-With a very low bleed chance, and the lowest damage out of any melee weapon, you'll have to use the shovels long reach to come out on top in any 1-on-1 duel
    [*]Snakes now react to slopes whilst moving
-This will generally produce more 'expected' movement, as snakes will move a lot slower when slithering up hills/cliffs
    [*]Improved snake pathfinding
-Snakes now no longer path through solid objects if they are above 10m tall
-Snakes will now almost always find a path to the player
    [*]The Triple Barrel now only fires 8 pellets of buckshot, as intended (down from 9)
    [*]Decreased global starting item spawns by 2
-This is a fairly large change, as it will mean less loot at the start of the round in some high value spawners, like the airfield, but the same amount of loot over the entire round
    [*]Made most SFX directional
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Can no longer make bets less than $100
    [*]Fixed scale of house in Nanga Pass
    [*]Optimized audio pooling
    [*]Fixed dodgy audio on local player (Thanks Black for reporting this)
    [*]Got rid of bugged popping sound when joining a round
    [*]Fixed Vityaz dual mag not reloading
     [*]Improved timing of Vityaz reload sound
    [*]Fixed some C36G red dot sights from being opaque

notes.title: Update 0.36 - Introducing the Triple Barrel
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

They say 3's a lucky number. With tonight's patch, it's time to put that to the test, with the introduction of the triple-barrel shotgun!
As well as a new weapon, we've got some spawn changes, plenty of bugfixes, improvements to betting, new pathfinding, and more!

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the triple barrel shotgun
-Firing 12GA shells (buckshot by default), the triple barrel shotgun can fire 3 shots in quick succession
-Want to load up a couple of slugs, and then a buckshot shell just in case things get hairy? Each shell in the triple barrel is simulated, so you can load in any combination you want
    [*]Refactored weapon scripts 
    [*]Added 12 Gauge Slugs
-Effective out to a few hundred metres, two of these slugs to the chest will stop most players dead in their tracks
    [*]Added 12 Gauge Buckshot
-With a damage dropoff starting at 15 metres, this 8-pellet shell is effective at close quarters only
    [*]Decreased Vityaz spawn rate in military areas
    [*]Added new Navmesh pathfinding for snakes
-As part of the framework for future AI in Down To One, snakes now actually pathfind, instead of beelining to their target. This is a general nerf to snakes, as there will be some situations where snakes are unable to find a valid path to a player.
    [*]The playable area now starts 60 seconds later
-This should give players a bit longer to explore the map, and increase the viability of heading towards areas like Doda or the Secluded Well
    [*]Removed shadows from minimum quality settings
    [*]Bloom no longer applies until "Medium" quality setting is chosen, this should give a nice boost in performance to GPU-bound systems running on Low
    [*]Reduced primary weapon spawn rates at some low residential spawners
    [*]Reduced Silenced 1911 spawn rates in some houses
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed 2nd + 3rd place bets not working
    [*]Improved betting error messages
    [*]Increased the size of the scout model, and removed the shadow it cast when "invisible"
    [*]Fixed another condition that could cause scoped weapons to bug out when ADSing
    [*]Fixed interaction events not being reliable - this should mean less invisible weapons
-We're also pretty close to finding a solution to the "invis-weapons-after-joining" bug - this should be fixed by the next patch
    [*]Server-side RAM + CPU optimizations
[/list]

[b]Weekly Cup #7[/b]
Don't forget to signup for our 7th weekly cup! [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/14/weekly-cup-7-lock-n-load]Signup now[/url] for your chance to play some great games & win some nice prizes, anyone can play!

notes.title: High Stakes - Update 0.35
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch adds in our first implementation of a new mechanic to spice up post-death gameplay - in-game betting! We've also got a few bugfixes, some spawning tweaks, and a bit of weapon balance in as well.

Read on for the full patch notes. 

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added new betting system (initial implementation)
-Currently, you can make a bet on which player/s you think will:
-Win the round 
-Place 1st & 2nd in the round ("Exacta")
-Place 1st, 2nd, & 3rd in the round ("Trifecta")
-Our first implementation of betting is available through in-game chat commands, type !betting in chat to get a list of available commands
    [*]Reduced Scout, AKM & M4 spawn rates at the Old Airfield

    [*]New hit impact sounds on flesh
    [*]Increased M4 Horizontal and Vertical recoil
 [/list]

    [*]New drawer opening sound

notes.title: United at Last - Update 0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

You've been waiting. It's finally here - Down To One is now running on Unity 5, with a huge raft of optimizations, changes, improvements, additions, and bugfixes in tonight's update as well. We are super excited for this patch, and the future possibilities & freedom that developing on Unity 5 offers.

Read on for the full patch notes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added Painkillers
- Having trouble aiming when on low health? Find yourself with 'the shakes' too often? Make sure you loot up a bottle of painkillers next time you find them.
    [*]Added loading screen when joining a server
-The loading screen will also display a random helpful tip - pay attention!
    [*]Added new Fireaxe skin ([url=http://i.imgur.com/7hkVGgb.jpg]Check it out![/url])
    [*]Added "Message of the Day" popup to the main menu
-This MotD popup will also be used to feature a server from time to time, allowing for 1-click joining!
     [*]Added 2 new gesture types, Chest Pump & Facepalm
     [*]Added detail textures to various objects around the map
     [*]Everyone can now switch who they're spectating (with E & Q)
     [*]Improved many building shaders & textures
     [*]Replaced old shadow system with new Unity 5 shadows, which perform much better & render at longer distances
-Currently there is a bug which causes the players first-person shadows to not render, this will be fixed
     [*]Upon joining a server, your screen will now fade in after loading everything
     [*]Moved all old PBR shaders to the new Unity Uber-Shader
     [*]Updated anti-cheat & added new cheat detectors
     [*]Decreased load times & improved startup video performance
     [*]Re-worked Quality Settings 
-Now, the quality settings in the launcher actually affect everything in-game, instead of just LOD & textures - if you've changed any video settings, make sure to use the "Custom" quality setting for those changes to be applied in-game
     [*]Screenshots captured with F12 are now dated properly
     [*]Added initial support for 5:4 aspect ratios
     [*]Increased radius of Artillery shells
     [*]Decreased Vityaz mag spawn rate
     [*]Added new (proper) tonemapping
     [*]Switched to forward rendering 
-As well as fixing some Unity 5 bugs, forward rendering also performed better in all tests we ran. Expect some very nice perf. increases!
     [*]More bird optimization
     [*]Various GC (Garbage Collection) optimizations, to decrease stutter
 [/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed some windows occluding the world outside them
    [*]Fixed some LODS & added new LODs for some weapons   
    [*]Item interactions are now more reliable, and less likely to cause various bugs, like the "stuck on hands" bug
     [*]Trees now look like they should, instead of having weird looking billboards
     [*]Various spectator fixes
     [*]Jumping will no longer cause you to throw a held rock
     [*]Sprinting now cancels ADSing
     [*]Spectators can no longer earn an infinite amount of cash by joining in-progress servers over & over
     [*]Decreased shader loading stutter (Thanks to the most recent Rust dev-blog for reminding us that we should be doing this as well!)
     [*]The chopper will now drop its weapons crate more towards the centre of the map
     [*]Various Unity 5 API changes, and general refactoring/optimization
 [/list]

As you can tell, we've made a lot of changes with this patch! A lot of code has been refactored from our Unity 4 version, so if any new bugs pop up, head on over to our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/334040/discussions/2/]Bug Reporting Forum[/url] and let us know - we'll get them fixed ASAP.

As always, don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting, and if you'd like Steam notifications for when matches are starting, join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/lpdto]Let's Play Down To One[/url] Steam group.

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: It's Getting Hot - Update v0.2.99
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight, we've got a new weapon, some spawning changes, bugfixes, & optimizations in store!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the Fire Extinguisher
-Dispensing compressed C02, the Fire Extinguisher can be dangerous if directed at an enemies face in close range.
-Currently, the fire extinguisher is 'too heavy' to be used as a melee weapon. This may change in a future patch ;)
    [*]After finishing a game, you are taking directly back into the "Play" menu
    [*]Increased round end reward by $100
    [*]Tweaked some spawners to continuously spawn throughout the round
    [*]Slightly increased 1911 mag spawn rates
 [/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Optimized smoke grenade performance
    [*]Various spawner bugfixes   
    [*]Decreased pop-in at the US Base
 [/list]

[b]DTO ODC #4[/b]
Congratulations to NitroFPS who took out last weekends cup! Also, a big thanks to [url= http://bit.ly/1Co8qpq]Mwave[/url] (Australia's largest online tech retailer) for supporting competitive DTO.

[b]Unity 5 Port Update[/b]
Currently, we're experiencing a critical silent build issue with Unity 5. After attempting various fixes for the last week (including re-working part of our UI, updating our networking framework, and removing a large portion of 3rd party tools/scripts), nothing has worked, and we are still left with a silent corruption error that prevents any built executable from our Unity 5 version from working. Once the next Unity 5 patch release is out, we'll be gutting every serialized reference between objects in the DTO project, which is the last known possible fix for this issue.

notes.title: Update 0.2.96 - Skins & More!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

It's time for a patch! As you are probably aware, we've been working around the clock over the past week to [url=http://downtoonegame.com/forums/Main-Forum/47/move-to-unity-5-update]bring Down To One to Unity 5[/url]. 
Although we'd intended to have the Unity 5 patch ready this week, we've hit a major roadblock with a new critical Unity 5 bug that breaks all functionality of our current GUI system in Unity 5. The good news is, we're now asynchronously rebuilding DTO's entire GUI with the new UGUI system in Unity 5, which should yield some great benefits in the long run. For now though, we'll be pushing a few more Unity 4 patches out until the GUI is rebuilt & Unity 5's [url=http://imgur.com/Pj63zsm,v09bF1e#0]other critical bugs[/url] are sorted out. Tonight, we've ported back some of the cool new changes we've made in the last week.

Tonight we've performed a reset of Cash & Perks with the new update to our Anticheat system, but as a thanks to all of our players (and a sorry for the delayed patch), every player has been given $50,001.

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Hit detection improvements
-Hits in our old system could sometimes be dropped if any server lag, or packet loss on either the shooter or receivers end occurred, which caused some hit detection issues. Our new system means that every time you hit someone - they will get damaged 100% of the time.
    [*]Updated Anticheat
    [*]Added 2 new C36G skins - Desert & Black
-See if you can spot them in-game!
    [*]Added speaker mode options in the main menu
-Stereo (default), Quad, 5.1, 7.1, & Prologic DSP
    [*]Reduced time between stopping & being ready to fire your rifle
    [*]Your crosshair will now not be visible whilst unable to shoot a weapon
    [*]Increased bandage spawn rate in residential spawners
    [*]Decreased AK47 bleed chance & severity
    [*]Slightly increased invulnerability timer after starting a round
 [/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Ladders now respect keybinds (thanks Yester!)
    [*]Reloading no longer bugs out if you drop your gun before finishing a reload
    [*]Carepackage smoke should no longer bug out
    [*]Various server-side bugfixes
 [/list]

Also, don't forget to sign up for the [url=http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/10/weekly-cup-3]Down To One weekly cup #3[/url] this weekend! We've had some great games the past 2 weekends, and are looking forward to more!

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting! 

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Weekly Cup #3 and Unity 5 port update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

We wanted to give everyone a quick status update on how things are going with the move to Unity 5, and announce our third weekly cup!

Read on for more.

[b]Weekly Cup #3[/b]
After a great Saturday full of competitive DTO action, NitroFPS took out first place in last weekends weekly cup, followed by Early Access Podcast (Don't Shoot Me) in second place, and Ancient in third. Thankfully, rocket-wells were not a contributor to the outcome of this cup, and the final moments of the Grand Final were great to watch! Check out the VoDs on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hIuYdBWOCNQ]Youtube Channel[/url].
This week, we've got another weekly cup lined up, which should be played on our Unity 5 patch once it's out! For more details & how to sign up, head on over to the [url=http://au.cybergamer.com/forums/thread/565190/Down-To-One-Weekly-One-Day-Cup-3-%28Saturday-2103%29/]Cybergamer thread here.[/url] As always, a big shoutout to our friends from [url=http://mwave.com.au]Mwave[/url] for supporting competitive DTO, and having great prices on PC hardware & more for Australian & New Zealand gamers!

[b]Unity 5 port update[/b]
Over the last week, we've been moving DTO over to Unity 5. Already, in-editor FPS has improved, from <25fps to >100, thanks to the 64bit editor, and as soon as we can get a build to work, we'll know how much client FPS has improved as well! 
Overall, quite a few things in Unity 5 are completely broken, which have slowed down the move as we find workarounds for them - trees, for instance, are [url=http://i.imgur.com/Pj63zsm.jpg]dependant on the Camera's background clear colour[/url] due to a (pretty massive) bug, they also [url=http://imgur.com/a/KUSyY#0]don't render properly[/url] in linear lighting (which is what DTO uses). 
Also, our first U5 patch won't include the fancy Global Illumination (pretty lighting) features that Unity 5 offers, due to another bug that prevents GI from baking in large scenes like ours, and reliably causes a BSOD with certain values checked.

With all that being said, we are currently still set for the Unity 5 patch to release tomorrow [strike](Tuesday)[/strike] Wednesday night at our regular patch time!

As always, don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting!

notes.title: Update v0.2.91 - Spectator Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch contains some new item spawn locations, graphics optimizations, and nice improvements to spectator mode, ahead of tomorrow's first DTO competition!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Aiming Down Sights/Scoping now shows in spectator mode
    [*]Added extra spectator functionality for approved spectators (if you're planning on hosting a competitive DTO event, or are a regular streamer, let us know!)
    [*]The player you are spectating will no longer clip into walls & other objects
    [*]Added bandages to the loot table of Tyre spawners
    [*]Increased bandage spawn rate in medium military areas
    [*]Added Bench spawner
    [*]Added Barrel spawner
    [*]Added extra Basket spawner
 [/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Your character will now properly receive environmental shadows if your shadow quality is set to 'medium' or above (note: 'very high' shadows are only recommended for screenshots/cinematics)
    [*]Decreased VRAM requirements by merging 2 post-process shaders into one pass
    [*]Added !fixmouselook command, as a workaround to a rare bug that can cause your mouse to rotate on the wrong axis
 [/list]

Also, don't forget to tune into our first Down To One tournament tomorrow ([url=http://www.timeanddate.com/countdown/to?iso=20150307T09&p0=196&msg=Down+To+One+Weekly+Cup+%231&csz=1]here's a handy countdown timer to the stream[/url]) on our [url=http://www.twitch.tv/downtoonegame]Twitch channel![/url]

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting! 

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update v0.2.9 - Big News
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch is mainly filled with bugfixes & usability improvements, we've also got some pretty big news to share! 

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]1st Stage of Ladder Rework
-Ladders are now integrated with the Interaction Systen
-Move to within range of a ladder, and press "Interact" to climb it
    [*]Decreased spawn timers in the garbage dump
    [*]Decreased sports drink spawn rate in small residential basket spawners
    [*]Decreased Vityaz mag spawn rate
    [*]Added 2 small loot spawns near Karaborum
 [/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Choppers now actually fly where they're supposed to (for real!)
    [*]The playable area no longer clips the camera
    [*]Re-enabled fog
    [*]Added !dropall command
-Forces your character to drop all items
 [/list]

Also, we're very happy to announce that Down To One will be moving to Unity 5! Unity 5 has tons of new features which should make DTO look better, perform better, and generally speed up development & open up more options once we've made the move. We're aiming to move after this weekend, we'll keep everyone updated!

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting! 

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update v0.2.8 - Smokes and Ladders
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch introduces smoke grenades, increased tickrates, ladder improvements and more!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the Smoke Grenade
-The Smoke Grenade can be found in both military & residential areas, and when thrown, will create a large, semi-opaque sphere of smoke for 25 seconds.
    [*]Increased base network tickrate by 10 packets/second (up from 20 to 30)
    [*]Increased max spawns from chopper Weapon Crate to 7 from 6
    [*]Ladders will now show when you can actually climb them, via the crosshair (this is a temporary helper mechanic until we do a complete ladder rework)
    [*]Death messages now show the name of the player that died
    [*]Added 5 more random spawn points around the map
    [*]Added extra low residential crate spawners in some areas
    [*]Added the "Competitions" tab in the main menu
 [/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Choppers will now always fly through the centre of the map, instead of sometimes flying very close to the edge of it
    [*]Fixed bug where flares & rocks could sometimes not be thrown
    [*]Flares now get removed from your inventory when thrown
 [/list]

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting! 
Also, today we announced our first official [url= http://downtoonegame.com/articles/news/esports/8/lets-get-competitive-dto-weekly-cup-1] Down To One Weekly Cup[/url]! A big thanks to [url= http://goo.gl/41rv9x]Mwave[/url] for supporting this event - we're very happy to be partnering up with the biggest & best online tech store in ANZ! 

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update 0.2.7 - Spring Cleaning
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch is filled with tons of bugfixes, usability improvements, and performance gains - thanks to everyone who's reported bugs so far - you'll probably find quite a few of them have been fixed this patch!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improved Weapon Crate smoke textures
    [*]The Weapon Crate should now spawn items on the ground, rather than in the air where it drops
    [*]After death, weapons will now drop out of players hands
    [*]Improved Item & general networking performance
    [*]Tweaked player speed, you will now move slightly faster side to side and backwards
    [*]Players can no longer shoot on ladders
    [*]Players can no longer shoot whilst gesturing
    [*]Increased P99 spawn rate in low residential areas
     [*]Added server name to in-game server/player menu
 [/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed camera not being able to look down far enough
    [*]Start Round countdown will no longer display multiple times
    [*]Refactored a lot of server-side code, servers will now no longer start "lagging" randomly
    [*]You can no longer activate the play dead perk whilst typing in chat 
    [*]Fixed Main Menu version panel
 [/list]

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting! Also, we've got an announcement about some regular events coming on Monday - stay tuned! (And in the meantime, make sure you're free next Saturday at around 9am GMT+8)!

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update 0.2.6 - Tree Hugging
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch adds in a new perk, and has a lot of extra behind-the scenes changes, like the changes made to our tree & bush shaders. This patch should fix the issue that many users with DX10 GPUs were reporting, let us know how it goes!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the "Pain Train" perk (thanks to TreJn for suggesting this perk!)
-Whilst bleeding, you become enraged, dealing 20% more damage 
    [*]Improved Bird animator performance
    [*]Improved look of carepackage smoke, and multithreaded the particle simulation
    [*]Added '-connect <ip> <port>' launch argument, this will also allow users to join games via links in their browser in the future
    [*]Reduced snake movement speed when attacking
    [*]Increased chance for Scout to spawn at the weapon crate drop
    [*]Reduced chance for all ironsighted weapons to spawn at the weapon crate drop 
-This should help define it as a high-value drop, and create more battles around it
    [*]Increased combat knife spawn rate in small crates & baskets
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed camera clipping issue when gesturing
    [*]Refactored terrain tree shaders - you should no longer experience "pink bushes" issues on DX10 level GPUs
    [*]Fixed bug where the chat box could disappear at annoying times
    [*]Fixed issue where the server would not send players cash after ending a round
[/list]

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting! Also, stay tuned for some competition announcements soon - we've got some exciting things coming up!

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update 0.2.5 - Play Dead
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

We've got a pretty big patch tonight, featuring a new perk, explodable fuel cans, and a new gesture system!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added "Play Dead" perk
-You can activate this perk to "Play Dead", falling over and becoming unable to move
-Whilst in this "Play Dead" state, you are unable to defend yourself, and take 20% more damage
    [*]Increased delay between a player dying, and the "A player has perished" message
    [*]Increased delay between a player dying, and the "Players Left" UI getting updated
    [*]Fuel cans now explode after being shot enough
    [*]Added "Surrender" gesture
    [*]Added "Fist Pump" gesture
    [*]Dead trees now have a higher chance of spawning a rock, and a lower chance of spawning water near them
    [*]Increased adrenaline spawn rate in low residential areas
    [*]Reduced food spawn rate in military hangars
    [*]Slightly reduced fall damage, and reduced random variation on fall damage
    [*]Decreased time the Chopper takes to drop the Weapon Crate
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]FXAA is now more resistant to noisy textures
    [*]Player gunshot audio now respects set volume
    [*]Thrown fuel cans will now correctly sync their position after landing
    [*]Removed 4x shader keywords from various shaders (preparation for DX10 fix)
[/list]

[b]Known bugs:[/b]
Looking around with gesture animations causes clipping issues with the camera.

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting!

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update 0.2.4 - Where Am I?
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch adds in one of the most highly-requested features as an alternate gamemode - random spawns! This is our first iteration of the gamemode, so it's probably not balanced perfectly at the moment, so make sure you jump in, have a game, and give us your feedback on it!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added Random Spawns gamemode
-Players will still start off in the lobby area, but will be teleported (placeholder) to a random spawnpoint at round start.
    [*]Reduced axe damage slightly
    [*]Reduced knife damage slightly
    [*]Increased AKM spawn rate in guard towers
    [*]Increased Makarov spawn rate in low residential areas
    [*]VOIP is now rebindable in the launcher
    [*]Bloom effect now applies to the first-person camera, if toggled
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed Main Menu UI on 4:3 and 16:10 aspect ratios
    [*]Player Inventory GUIs will no longer reset when a new player/spectator joins the server
    [*]Smoothed helicopter movement
    [*]Fixed issue where a dead player could still deal damage with a melee weapon, if they had started swinging it before dying
    [*]When loading into a server, other servers in the list become un-clickable
[/list]

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting!

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update v0.2.3 - Did someone say "VOIP"?
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight we're adding our first iteration of 3d positional VOIP into Down To One. We're excited to see the new player-player interactions this creates, so dust off your microphones, and jump on in!

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added directional VOIP
-Hold down B to start speaking (currently there is no UI indicator)
-If you want to mute VOIP in the starting area, simply turn your SFX volume in-game down to 0
-We are looking to improve the quality of the VOIP codec in the future
    [*]The playable area moves to its target location over a longer period of time
    [*]Doors on houses can now be closed
    [*]Improved throwaway animation
    [*]Added basic player list (accessed through the in-game menu)
    [*]Added "Demo" gamemode, which is suited to 2 players
-In "Demo", the playable area starts sooner and shrinks more frequently, and will always target Aras as an end point
-We'll be showcasing Down To One tomorrow at the Perth [url=http://www.wai-con.org/showdown/]AniGames[/url] event, if you live in Perth, come say hi!
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]The playable area is now actually visible when it comes into effect, instead of only becoming visible on first decrease
    [*]Fixed firemode not working sometimes (thanks Yester!)
    [*]Fixed pistol animation bugging out when transitioning from running-walking
[/list]

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting, like our 42 player event this Friday!

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update v0.2.2 - Get Pumped!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight's patch includes a new item, some pretty major Playable Area changes, and of course, tons of fixes! 

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improved Steam Stats integration
-Added "Damage Dealt" stat.
    [*]Increased round start countdown to 15 seconds from 5 seconds
    [*]Players can now punch while walking
    [*]Playable area changes
-The Playable Area will now gradually move & decrease, instead of instantly
-Until the playable area has reached its new location, you will not be damaged if you are outside of it
    [*]Added Adrenaline
-When used, Adrenaline boosts your movement speed by 10%, and gives you infinite stamina for 10 seconds

notes.title: Update v0.2.0 - New Gamemode, Gun, and Perk!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Tonight we've got a nice big update lined up, featuring a new gamemode, a new gun, and a new perk! 

Read on for the full patchnotes.

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the AKM Assault Rifle
-The AKM is a powerful close-mid range weapon, with its relatively slow firerate making recoil easy to control.
-Using the same 7.62x39mm ammunition as the AK47, ammo should not be an issue for the AKM.
-The AKM is the most reliable weapon in-game, even when damaged it's spread is very low.
    [*]Added "Practice" Gamemode
-The Practice gamemode allows players to do exactly that - practice. Get a feel of the map, check out where the best loot areas are, or just run around.
-Some new servers will come up this patch, running the Practise gamemode
-The Practice gamemode only requires one player to start a server
    [*]Added the "Antivenom" perk
-As some players have discovered, snakes can be a little OP (OverPowered) at times. With the Antivenom perk, this is no longer a concern, mitigating all damage taken from a snake strike.
    [*]Added another Snake spawnpoint
    [*]Added UI action for losing health via hunger
    [*]Added UI action for losing health via thirst
    [*]Added UI action for losing health when attacked
    [*]Added Sun Shafts (turn them on in Video Settings)
    [*]Added Gamma slider (in most cases, the default value is fine)
    [*]Slightly reduced damage on the knife-hand strike & punch
    [*]Improved hit detection on players that are holding weapons
    [*]Increased size of bullet impact particle effects
    [*]Bullet impacts are now networked - this should give you a better indication of when you have been hit
    [*]Improved terrain near the artillery craters
    [*]Increased spread of items in the Garbage Dump
    [*]Increased maximum item spawns in the Garbage Dump from 8 to 10
    [*]In spectator mode, the inventory UI panel is now hidden
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed issue where readying up could put a you into spectator mode
    [*]The "You are out of the playable area" message will no longer appear in spectator mode
    [*]Fixed medic perk always being applied
    [*]Fixed grammatical error in the Vityaz' description
    [*]Improved animation transitions (this should fix the 'pistol-to-walk-shows-chest' bug)
    [*]Weapons crate spawns should now spawn more items, as intended
    [*]Increased timer on "Players Dead" chat message
    [*]Fixed rare bug that would cause the playable area to not decrease sometimes
[/list]

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting.

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Update v0.19.8 - Double Trouble
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

It's time for the first update in our two-day major patch cycle, and we've got a pretty massive update ready for everyone, with a new type of primary weapon, 2 new perks, tons of fixes, and a big balance sweep - read on for the full patchnotes!

[b]Improvements & Additions[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the Vityaz SMG. 
-Firing controllable 9x19mm parabellum rounds from either of its dual 30 round mags, the Vityaz is an effective close quarters weapon.
-At range, the Vityaz' damage starts to drop off at 60 meters, combined with its poor accuracy, you won't be making many long-range kills with it.
-The Vityaz has the highest chance of any primary weapon to spawn in low residential spawners
    [*]Added the Medic perk, which increases the amount healed from bandages by 400%. The medic perk can only be unlocked once you've reached level 10.
    [*]Added the Martial Arts perk, which lets you perform a knife-hand strike (animation is still a WIP), for twice the damage of a normal punch. Unlocked at level 10
    [*]Players can now join in-progress servers to spectate
    [*]Rocks now deal a lot more damage
    [*]When viewing item tooltips, the tooltip will also show the amount of that item you have (so, the amount of ammo you have, for mags)
    [*]Added first-shot recoil to some guns when firing in semi-auto or burst
    [*]Levels now have a use, to unlock some new perks.
    [*]Decreased Scout spawn rate
    [*]Increased Makarov mag spawn rate
    [*]Choppers should now fly through the middle of the map more often (and therefore drop their weapon crates closer to the middle of the map)
    [*]Set minimum players required to start a game to 5
    [*]Improved AK ironsights
    [*]Buffed snake movespeed and chase distance
    [*]Increased perk point cost of the "Healthy" perk
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]If the game has started, players will not be added to the "players left" if they join
    [*]Rebaked occlusion culling
    [*]Fixed various null reference exceptions on the server
    [*]XP/Cash is now actually rewarded on round win 
    [*]Improved animation transitions, so changing from a secondary>primary whilst running will no longer bug out
    [*]Increased shadow performance on lower settings
    [*]The server will now accept requests to connect if the round has started (for spectating)
    [*]Removed some useless debug logging
    [*]Bushes and trees [i]shouldn't[/i] be pink anymore on DX10 GPUs (let us know how this goes)
[/list]

[b]Known Bugs[/b]
[list]
    [*]The client-side "Players left" UI can sometimes report the wrong amount of players left. This is only a visual UI issue.
[/list]

Now that we're reaching a good point in terms of stability and core features, we can & will be focusing on bringing more new players into Down To One - playerbase is now a major focus for us!

Don't forget to follow us [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]on Twitter[/url] for minute-to-minute status updates and notifications of when games & events are starting.

We'll see you in-game!

notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

As you may have guessed from the title, tonight's patch introduces a new creature into the game - snakes! As well as this new environmental danger, we've got some other pretty cool changes and improvements on the way for the update - read on for the full patchnotes!

[b]Improvements & Additions[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added snakes. Snakes will generally spawn in the rocky areas which are usually camped by players toward the end of the game.
    [*]Snakes can be killed with any standard weapon in one hit, or with your fists in 3 hits.
    [*]Snakes will attack the closest player to them, with their venom also affecting the players thirst level
    [*]Environment - added some explosion burn-marks & ditches in the valley before the airfield

    [*]Removed knives from spawn area
    [*]Added another house in the area to the left of the Northern Outlook
    [*]Reduced maximum time for chopper to drop, so it will drop earlier in the round
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Stamina no longer depletes when climbing ladders
    [*]Rebaked occlusion culling
    [*]Fixed server sometimes thinking there were more players in the round than there actually were
    [*]Fixed playable area UI sometimes not showing the correct information
    [*]The heading UI in spectator mode should now work based on the player you are spectating
    [*]The area UI in spectator mode should now work based on the player you are spectating
    [*]Player name changes will now save correctly (and shouldn't revert back to your Steam name)
    [*]Chat is now encoded in UTF-8

notes.title: Patch v0.19.6 - Double Rewards
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

For tonights patch, we've focused on improving some core systems including experience, and server variations. This patch will reset XP.

Also, after tomorrow nights patch, we'll be improving the amount of content we add with each patch, by switching to a 2-day patch cycle. Now that we're getting more stable, a 2-day patch cycle allows us to focus on really big improvements & features, without rushing them out every day.

Read on for the full patchnotes:

[b]Improvements and additions[/b]
[list]
    [*]Slightly decreased AK side-to-side recoil
    [*]Lowered base volume of out of breath sound
    [*]Levels are now reset, and when you reach max level, this will be indicated correctly. 
    [*]Level XP values balanced
    [*]Choppers will now drop weapon crates closer to the middle of the map
    [*]The playable area will jitter in a larger area, so the end-point should have a higher variance each round    
    [*]Added Double XP/Cash option for some servers
    [*]Improved soccer ball hit detection (note: hit detection may suffer with higher pings/more players kicking the ball at the moment)
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Melee weapons dropped by dead players should no longer be able to hit/hurt you
    [*]Increased server restart delay by 20 seconds at the end of each round (this should fix winners not getting XP)
    [*]Fixed unclimbable guard tower at the airfield
    [*]Improved server-side performance, and removed some null reference exceptions
    [*]XP would sometimes not tick properly, this has been fixed
[/list]

As always, stay tuned to our [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame]Twitter[/url] for constant updates! 

We'll see you in-game!

Also, after tomorrow nights patch, we'll be improving the amount of content we add with each patch, by switching to a 2-day patch cycle. Now that we're getting more stable, a 2-day patch cycle allows us to focus on really big improvements & features, without rushing them out every day.

Read on for the full patchnotes:

[b]Improvements and additions[/b]
[list]
    [*]Slightly decreased AK side-to-side recoil
    [*]Lowered base volume of out of breath sound
    [*]Levels are now reset, and when you reach max level, this will be indicated correctly. 
    [*]Level XP values balanced
    [*]Choppers will now drop weapon crates closer to the middle of the map
    [*]The playable area will jitter in a larger area, so the end-point should have a higher variance each round    
    [*]Added Double XP/Cash option for some servers
    [*]Improved soccer ball hit detection (note: hit detection may suffer with higher pings/more players kicking the ball at the moment)
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Melee weapons dropped by dead players should no longer be able to hit/hurt you
    [*]Increased server restart delay by 20 seconds at the end of each round (this should fix winners not getting XP)
    [*]Fixed unclimbable guard tower at the airfield
    [*]Improved server-side performance, and removed some null reference exceptions
    [*]XP would sometimes not tick properly, this has been fixed
[/list]

As always, stay tuned to our [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame]Twitter[/url] for constant updates! 

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Patch v0.19.5 - Fun and Games
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

You know what time it is! Tonight, we're implementing not one, but two features! 

First up, is the base of our all-important stamina system, which will prevent players from spamming jump all around the map, and increase weapon sway when out of breath very slightly. 

Next up, we've added a highly requested feature to the starting area - makeshift Soccer! With our PBR-rendered soccer ball, it's not only a great time to kill time while waiting for a round to start, but if you score a goal, you'll earn some XP + Cash as well! (Note: use G to kick)

Read on for the full patchnotes:

[b]Improvements and additions[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added soccer to starting area
    [*]Added base stamina system
    [*]Increased playable area movement variance 
    [*]The camera now doesn't get as dark on low HP
    [*]Increased axe swing animation speed slightly
    [*]Increased shelling frequency in hotzones
    [*]Players now earn XP on killing another player (this is not displayed on-screen intentionally)
    [*]Added interpolation to spectator cam Y axis, for smoother spectating
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Iron sights now rebind properly
    [*]Made second sight button rebindable
    [*]Made Escape rebindable
    [*]Improved jumping animation & transition speeds
    [*]Shadows now default to on
    [*]Hurt sounds will no longer play after death
    [*]Fists no longer create bullet impacts
    [*]Refactored some ADS code - let us know if you still experience the "falling-through-map" issue when scoping
[/list]

As always, stay tuned to our [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame]Twitter[/url] for constant updates! 

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Patch 0.19.4 - Life After Death
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

Time for another update! Tonight, we're implementing a very widely requested feature - the first iteration of a post-death spectator camera! 

It's pretty simple - once you die, after a few seconds, you will start to spectate a random player in your game. At the moment, to prevent targeted 'ghosting', the player you spectate is random. As always, we'll look to improve and build upon various aspects of this spectator camera in the future - this is just a start.

Read on for the full patchnotes:

[b]Improvements and additions[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added post-death spectator camera
    [*]Slightly increased fist damage
    [*]Improved hit detection
    [*]Fists can now only deal damage 10 seconds after the round has started
    [*]On death, added a death 'reason' message, so you know why you died
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Removed weird right-hand chop animation
    [*]Fixed terrain near one of the Hangars on the Airfield
    [*]Fixed all static rocks that were floating above terrain
    [*]Made hurt sounds respect set volume
    [*]Improved the "You placed X out of X" message
    [*]Tweaked player-environment collision
    [*]Fixed bug where players could swing around after death
    [*]Fixed P99 firing animation
    [*]Fists no longer play impact sounds when hitting walls/terrain
    [*]Updated Bolt to .4.2.7 (now the server list should show the *actual* players in a server
    [*]Updated Zeus Master Server to v .1.7.3 
[/list]

As always, stay tuned to our [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame]Twitter[/url] for constant updates! 

We'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Patch 0.19.3 - Get ready to rumble!
notes.content:

    [*]Players can no longer connect to a server if they're using an outdated version
    [*]Fixed ragdoll floating on death
    [*]Players will no longer be able to ascend into the sky after death
    [*]Fixed issue where players could use a knife before the round started
    [*]Fixed ladders on the tall house
[/list]

As always, stay tuned to our [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame]Twitter[/url] for constant updates!

notes.title: Patch 0.19.2 - Introducing the M4
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

It's time for another update! Tonight, as well as adding in a brand new primary weapon, the M4, we've completely overhauled our aiming-down-sights system, and improved recoil further. Now, your gun won't look like it's glued to the middle of the screen when you ADS, and crouching has more of an impact on gun accuracy.

Now, time for patchnotes!

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the M4 Carbine
    [*]-With a shorter effective range than the G36C, the M4 is a beast in close-quarters combat, with a higher firerate, and more controllable full-auto recoil.   
    [*]Decreased default amount of players required to force start a round (ready up)
    [*]Balanced weapon spawn rates in military areas
    [*]Added the M4 Magazine item
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed collision models on some houses & stairs
    [*]Further improved guard tower ladders (now, climbing past the top of the ladder should be fixed)
    [*]Fixed various floating rocks
    [*]Reduced animation transition times on equipping some weapons
    [*]Increased server-side logging
[/list]

Also, for all of our Oceanic players, we've now created a forum on ANZ's most popular competitive leagues website, [url=http://au.cybergamer.com/forums/40083/]Cybergamer[/url] - check it out!

As always, don't forget to hop on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/%5Bg:1:7604361%5D/announcements/detail/154581999417612880]Community Teamspeak[/url] to interact with other players and devs!

Game on!

notes.title: Introducing the Makarov - Patch v0.19
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

It's time for our second patch today, and a patch that we're very excited about. As well as adding the new Makarov pistol, this patch contains a whole bunch of critical fixes, changes, and improvements to Down To One - connection issues should no longer be an issue, we've stabilized our rounds system, and generally made some really exciting changes.

[b]Additions & Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the Makarov
    [*]Added the Makarov Mag
    [*]Now you can select from all 5 camos in customization, instead of just 3
    [*]Increased time between round restarting and players DCing
    [*]Animations - Added makarov animations
    [*]Post-death improvements - your mouse is no longer locked after death
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Animations - Weapon animations will no longer bug out if you switch to a weapon whilst sprinting
    [*]Networking - Updated Bolt networking to .2.4.5
    [*]Fixed a crash bug in the main menu
    [*]Rounds - completely refactored round ending, to prevent rounds from ending unexpectadly
    [*]Networking - Updated Master Server & fixed most remaining connection issues
    [*]Removed a useless message from the server
[/list]

We'll see everyone in-game!

notes.title: Patch v0.18!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

It's time for another patch! v0.18 contains lots of server-side fixes, some optimizations, and lots of general improvements. Find out what we changed below!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Gunplay - Now, the Scout sniper rifle is easier to aim when crouching, but harder when standing
    [*]Gunplay - Now, when players die, there is no longer a window of up to 400ms when they can still fire their gun - this should help a lot with kill trades
    [*]Added more throwable rocks around the map
    [*]Removed "# Players remain" constant server message
    [*]The compass is no longer confused about which directions are East and West
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed occlusion culling bugs (thanks to PsiSyndicate for finding one!)
    [*]Increased server restart delay when round is won
    [*]Servers actually restart in all scenarios now
    [*]Dead players weapons should now be able to be picked up (thanks to our community for reporting this!)
    [*]Scaled main menu UI slightly (still a WIP, use the Drag Handle at the top left if you're having issues)
    [*]Made video settings default to where they should 
    [*]Improved !stuck command - let us know how it goes
[/list]

We're also continuing to work on other community ideas, like random spawns - have your input on the forums!

[h1]Game on![/h1]

notes.content:

It's time for another patch! We'd initially scheduled this patch for last night, but as those of you following our [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame]Twitter[/url] feed learnt, a few downed power poles in our area had some other ideas!

notes.title: Patch 0.17 - Fixes, Fixes, Fixes!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

The focus on our patch today has been general stability issues, fixes, and usability improvements. Amongst other fixes, this patch should fix the issue where some users could not connect to servers via the server list. Let us know how it goes! [b]Update:[/b] Testing has revealed the bug will still need a Master Server update - you will not need to update your game clients - stay tuned. In the meantime, the default direct connect IP can be used for users suffering this issue.

[b]Patch notes:[/b]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed Master Server being unable to punch through Symmetric NATs, causing some users to be unable to join servers
    [*]Improved Main Menu stability
    [*]Clamped main menu drag amount, you can no longer drag the UI off-screen
    [*]More fixes to boundaries in the spawn area
    [*]Fixed a collision issue with a house in Nanga Pass (thanks to mcpisikak for reporting this issue)
    [*]Fixed !diagnostics being server-side
    [*]Fixed screen resolution issues in video settings (thanks to various community members for reporting this)
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Allowed individual servers to have different default minimum player amounts, and set the default amount of players ready required to start a round to 20
    [*]Made playable area invisble until it actually starts
    [*]Added ping on server browser (first implementation, this will improve)
    [*]Added ability to hide in-progress servers from server browser
    [*]The pistol is now a 1-headshot kill, not taking into account perks, from within its optimal range
    [*]Slightly improved guard tower ladders (note: we are still planning a full ladder rework)
    [*]Bullets now can penetrate transparent objects, like the thin wire fence
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
Added !stuck command, we are aware of a rare issue causing players to get stuck, but have been unable to reproduce it. Let us know how this fix goes.

As always, the best way to keep up to date is via our [url=https://twitter.com/DownToOneGame/]Twitter[/url] for constant updates!

notes.title: New Update! Patch 0.16
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone,[/h1]

We've been listening to everyones feedback throughout the course of the day, and this patch is our first go at solving high-priority problems, and adding in a few community-requested features as well.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Spawn area collision fixes. No more glitching through spawn!
    [*]Fixed issue where server would sometimes not restart until all players had not DCed
    [*]Fully removed mouse clamping when using Raw Mouse Input
    [*]Tweaked drawer spawn points, now less items should spawn and fall through the drawers
    [*]Made chat textbox automatically close after sending message
    [*]Fixed server null reference spam & bird animations
    [*]Fixed bug where trying to drink/eat with a rock/fuel can in hands would cause the player to glitch out
[/list]

[b]Features & Additions[/b]
[list]
    [*]Made servers now show up in the list as "In Progress" if they are in a round (note: this is still a WIP)
    [*]Increased hunger restore amount on some food items
    [*]Community request: Added inverted Y mouse option
    [*]Community request: Added "Ready" option in in-game menu, no need to type !ready in chat anymore!
    [*]Lowered default server minimum player ready amount from 21 to 14
[/list]

As always, we are continuing to test out & improve various connectivity issues, we will keep those affected up to date as we progress. For now, forwarding ports:
2220-2230
On your router may allow you to connect to our EU & NA servers.

Thanks,

-The Down To One team
